So the two rabbits shared the pretty carrot while hopping around in the field. They had a lot of fun and ate the whole carrot!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat snacks, especially crackers and cheese. One day, her mom told her she couldn't have a snack because it was almost dinner time. Lily was sad, but she surrendered and waited for dinner.

Later that evening, Lily's dad came home from work. He had a harsh day at work and was feeling grumpy. Lily tried to cheer him up by giving him a hug and a kiss. Her dad's face softened and he smiled. He realized he had surrendered to his bad mood and needed to be more positive.

After dinner, Lily's parents surprised her with a special snack - ice cream! Lily was so happy and grateful. She surrendered to the joy of the moment and enjoyed every bite. From that day on, Lily learned that surrendering to the good things in life can bring happiness.

Lily was a lazy girl. She often didn't want to do anything. Everything felt like too much effort. But one day, something inside of her changed.

She found a paintbrush and some paints lying around. As she looked at them, she felt excited. She began painting on the wall next to her.

She painted all sorts of things. She painted the sky, trees, and flowers. She really brought the painting to life!

When she was finished, she stepped back and looked at what she had created. She was so proud of herself. She realized that if you put your mind to it, you can do anything.

From then on, Lily never felt lazy anymore. Painting had made a huge difference in her life, and she was so happy!

Lily loved to watch the sky when it was stormy. She liked to see the big clouds and hear the loud thunder. Sometimes, she saw bright flashes of lightning that made the sky look like a big firework. She thought lightning was very pretty and exciting.

One night, Lily was in her bed and heard a big boom outside. She ran to the window and saw a perfect lightning bolt. It was long and thin and zigzagged across the sky. It was white and yellow and purple and blue. Lily smiled and clapped her hands. She wanted to remember the perfect lightning bolt forever.

She ran to her desk and got a paper and a crayon. She tried to draw the lightning bolt on the paper. She made a line that went up and down and sideways. She colored it with different colors. She was very proud of her drawing. She showed it to her mom and dad and they said it was very good.

Lily put her drawing on the wall next to her bed. She looked at it every night before she went to sleep. She remembered the perfect lightning bolt and how it made her feel happy and amazed. She dreamed of more lightning bolts and more storms and more beautiful skies. She loved to watch the sky when it was stormy.

Once upon a time there was a poor witch. One day she was walking through the woods when she heard a loud sound. She looked up and saw an arrow shooting through the sky. She caught the arrow and saw that it was from a little boy with a bow and arrow.

The witch said: "Hello, little boy! Why are you shooting arrows?"

The boy said: "I'm trying to hit apples off the tree so I can eat them."

The witch said: "That's a very brave thing to do. Do you need any help?"

The boy said: "Yes, please! I could use some help."

So the witch used her magic to make a ladder appear so the little boy could climb up to get his apples. The little boy was so happy, he gave the witch a big hug and thanked her for being so helpful.

The witch smiled and said: "You're welcome, little one. Always remember to help those who are poor like me."

The boy thanked the witch again and the witch flew away on her broomstick. The little boy was very happy and he thanked the witch for all her help.

Once there was a girl named Kaitlyn who wanted to play with her silver marker. But it was missing! Kaitlyn looked everywhere but still couldn't find it.

She became very frustrated and cried loudly. She asked her mom to help her find the silver marker. Her mom looked in every corner of the house, but there was no sign of the marker.

Kaitlyn's mom then had an idea. She took Kaitlyn to the store to get a new marker. Kaitlyn was so excited when she saw so many silver markers at the store. She couldn't choose which was the prettiest.

In the end, Kaitlyn picked a sparkly, silver marker. She couldn't wait to start using it. She immediately went home and started to draw on the walls. Kaitlyn made beautiful art and was very proud of her silver marker.

Once there was a wise old bird. He liked to watch the world around him. One day, he noticed a squash in the garden. He had never seen such a thing before! So he got closer to take a look. He noticed a white skin with little green bumps, and a sweet smell. His eyes opened wide. He wanted to try the squash! He pecked at it and ate some of the soft, yellow inside. It was delicious! The wise old bird enjoyed the tasty squash and never forgot it. He was sure he would come back soon to try some more.

Once upon a time there was a rich man who lived in a big house on a hill. He had a special room in his house. It was filled with toys and treats but he refused to let anyone else see what was inside.

One day, a zigzag came to visit the man. It asked him if it could go in the special room and see what was inside. But the rich man refused. He kept the door closed and wouldn't let the zigzag in.

The zigzag was so sad. It tried to think of a way to get the rich man to let it in, but nothing worked. Until finally, the zigzag had an idea. It smiled, then ran around the hill in a zigzag pattern.

When the rich man saw this, he was so surprised and amused. He smiled, opened the door and let the zigzag have a look around.

The zigzag was so happy! It ran around the room, looking at all the toys and treats. It spent the day playing with all the exciting things it found inside. The rich man was happy too and he never refused the zigzag again.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Flossy. Flossy was three years old and she was very curious. One day she was in her dad's wardrobe and she found a pair of sunglasses. She had never seen these before and she felt very curious. She wanted to know what they were. She carefully tried them on and saw the world around her in a different way.

Suddenly Flossy saw something disgusting on the ground. It was a big gooey bug! Flossy was so scared and she quickly put the sunglasses away and ran out of the wardrobe. She knew she had to tell her dad about the bug.

When dad heard the news he put on his sunglasses and went to inspect. Sure enough, the bug was still there and he quickly got rid of it. After that Flossy never put on the sunglasses again. She knew that she'd been very lucky that day and she never wanted to find something disgusting ever again!

Once upon a time there was a black infant. He rested in his crib all day and watched the world outside his window. Every day he saw old birds flying in the sky and young children playing in the grass. Every night he heard the night creatures stirring in the darkness.

One day the infant decided he wanted to explore outside his window. He pushed his way out of the crib and flopped into the grass below. He was amazed by the world around him. Everything seemed so big and he was so small.

He rested near a tree and looked up in the sky. He saw a blackbird flying above him and then he noticed a yellow butterfly fluttering near his face. He reached out to touch it, but it flew away.

The infant watched until the sun began to set. When it was too dark to see he tucked himself back into his crib and closed his eyes. He felt tired and content after his exploration. The night was peaceful and he soon fell asleep, happy to rest after a full day of adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. She lived in a small house with her mommy and daddy. Sally had a neighbor named Mr. Brown. Mr. Brown was a nice man, but he had an ugly hat. The hat was big and green with a red bow. Sally did not like the hat, but she liked Mr. Brown.

One day, Sally saw the ugly hat on the ground outside Mr. Brown's house. She wanted to help, so she picked up the hat. Sally walked to Mr. Brown's door and knocked. When Mr. Brown opened the door, Sally put the ugly hat in his hand. She said, "I found your hat, Mr. Brown."

Mr. Brown smiled and thanked Sally. He put the ugly hat on his head and said, "Now my head will not be cold." Sally was happy that she helped her neighbor. From that day on, she thought the ugly hat was not so bad after all.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who loved to explore. He wanted to see all the wonders of the world.

So one day he walked and walked until he came to the edge of a huge forest. He was excited to explore the forest.

He ventured in. Soon enough, he came across an extraordinary sight. A giant tree that had a swing that went way up high, so high he could touch the sky. He was so excited he just had to give it a try. So he climbed up the tree and squeezed himself onto the swing seat.

He started swinging and swaying and before long he was feeling so merry and carefree. Suddenly, he felt a massive hand squeeze him tight. He looked around and saw an old and miserable giant. The giant spoke in a grumbling voice, "You don't belong in my forest, get away!"

The little boy was scared and quickly jumped down from the swing. He was so sad, he had to leave the wonderful adventure he had been having. He quietly went home, feeling more than a little miserable.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy family who had a big table. One day, the table broke and the family was sad. The father said, "We need to replace the table." The mother and the children agreed.

They went to the store and found a new table. It was big and shiny. The family was happy again. "This table is better than the old one," said the son. "Yes, it is," said the mother. They all sat at the new table and ate dinner. It was a good day.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Frank. Frank was three years old. One day, he decided to go on a walk.

As he walked, he heard the sound of a distant violin. Frank saw a man playing the violin and it made him very happy. He wanted to make music too, so he asked the man if he could try.

The man said yes, so Frank grabbed the violin. He held it in his hands and tried to make some music. But instead of making beautiful music, Frank started to slap the violin.

The man laughed and said he should try playing the strings. So Frank tried! He moved his fingers over the strings and made the most wonderful sound. Frank was so proud of himself and he clapped his hands.

The man thanked him and said goodbye. Frank waved goodbye and watched him walk away until he was nothing but a distant memory. Frank then smiled, happy to have made music that made the man smile.

One day, Tommy was playing outside at sunset. He could see the wide sky changing colors from blue to orange, and he was very excited. He started pointing up at the sky, saying "Look! The sunset is so beautiful!"

Suddenly, his mom came outside. She smiled at Tommy and said, "You're right! It's a gorgeous sunset. I wish we could stay here and watch it together."

Tommy's dad came outside too and looked up. He pointed to the sky and said, "Wow! Look at how wide it is!"

Tommy ran up and hugged his mom and dad. He was so happy they were all looking at the sunset together. They were a family, and nothing was better than that!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to walk around the park with his mommy. One day, while they were walking, Timmy saw a squirrel and got very excited. He ran towards the squirrel, but he tripped and fell. His mommy picked him up and hugged him tightly. "Are you okay?" she asked. Timmy rubbed his waist and said, "I'm okay, mommy. I just fell down."

After a while, they continued walking and saw a pond. Timmy wanted to go near it, but his mommy said, "No, Timmy. It's not safe." Timmy felt calm and held his mommy's hand. Suddenly, a big dog appeared and started barking at them. Timmy got scared and started crying. His mommy tried to calm him down, but the dog bit Timmy's leg. Timmy had to go to the hospital and get a shot. He was very sad and scared, but his mommy hugged him and said, "It's okay, Timmy. You're going to be fine."

Once upon a time, there was a little otter. The otter had many friends in the forest. They liked to play and have fun together. But one day, the otter got upset.

The otter and his friend, the squirrel, had a quarrel. They were both angry and did not want to play anymore. The otter felt sad and went to sit by the river alone.

Soon, the squirrel came to the otter and said sorry. The otter said sorry too. They hugged and became friends again. They played near the river and were happy. The otter was not upset anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a family of four. They had a mummy, a daddy, and two little children. One day, the two children were playing in the garden together and they saw a vase.

The mummy said â€œRemember, be very careful with it children - it is very old and fragileâ€.

The children continued to play in the garden and after a while, mummy called them for dinner. The children remembered the vase and quickly put it back where they had found it.

Once inside, mummy noticed the children had been careful and praised them for being so sensible. The children smiled, happy that they had remembered to put the vase back where it belonged.

Once upon a time, there lived a very curious girl called Lucy. One day, she asked her mum a million questions. She wanted to know everything there was to know.

Mum laughed and said, "Let me show you something that will help you answer all your questions."

Mum took Lucy to a special room and gave her a microscope. Lucy was thrilled! She put the microscope on the table and peered in.

"Ooh, what do I see?" she asked.

"It looks like a spicy pepper," Mum replied.

Lucy got even more excited. She examined the pepper closely with the microscope.

"It has little black seeds!" Lucy exclaimed.

"Yes, and those seeds are what make the pepper spicy," Mum explained.

Lucy smiled and said, "Now I can answer all my questions!"

Mum smiled too, happy that her daughter was so curious.

Once upon a time, there was a big and mighty lion. He had a desk where he liked to sit and think. One day, his friend the zebra came to visit him. The lion asked the zebra if he wanted to play a game, but the zebra disagreed.

The lion asked the zebra why he didn't want to play. The zebra said he was tired and wanted to rest. The lion understood and let the zebra take a nap on his desk. While the zebra slept, the lion quietly watched over him.

When the zebra woke up, he thanked the lion for being such a good friend. They agreed to play a game together another day. The lion was happy that he could help his friend and the zebra was happy to have such a mighty friend.

John was celebrating his third birthday and was super excited. He was wearing a colourful mask and had invited all his friends to his house. They were all in the backyard, playing games and having fun.

Suddenly, Johnâ€™s mom said to all the children, â€œTime to organize the birthday cake before itâ€™s dark outside!â€. The children all ran to help John's mom. John was so graceful as he managed to carry the cake to the backyard.

John was so proud of his mask, as he had made it with his mom. Everyone started singing 'Happy Birthday' to John, who had bought a special candle to put on the cake.

Just as they had finished singing, a strong wind blew and the mask that John was wearing flew away.

John was devastated and started crying. He yelled at his friends, telling them it was all their fault. His friends were so sad to see him so angry and they quickly ran away.

John's mom tried to comfort him, but he was too angry. John just wanted his birthday back, but it was too late. His birthday had ended in disaster.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very restless because he couldn't find his favorite folder. He searched high and low, but he couldn't find it anywhere.

Timmy's mom noticed he was sad and asked him what was wrong. Timmy told her he couldn't find his folder. His mom said, "Don't worry, Timmy. Let's drink some juice and then we can look for your folder together."

After they drank juice, Timmy and his mom looked for the folder. Timmy looked under his bed and found it! He was so happy and said, "Mom, look! I found my folder!"

His mom smiled and said, "I'm so proud of you, Timmy. You did a great job finding your folder." Timmy felt happy and proud. He hugged his mom and said, "Thanks for helping me, Mom."

Once there was a little girl named Sophie. Sophie was three years old and very impatient. One day she noticed a stitch in her shirt. She became very excited and started to laugh.

She grabbed her mommyâ€™s sewing box and found a needle and some thread. She was determined to fix the stitch by herself! She tried very hard to do it, but she was only three and couldnâ€™t manage it.

Sophie got very impatient, so she called for help. Her mommy came and saw Sophie trying to sew the stitch. She smiled at her and said â€œSophie, let me help youâ€.

Sophie smiled, thankful that her mommy was there to help. She watched as her mommy skillfully stitched the hole. When she was finished, Sophie laughed and hugged her mommy, happy that her shirt was fixed.

Once there was a wealthy family with three kids. Two of them were in university, but the youngest one was only three. He wanted to go to university too!

One day, the three university students decided to take the youngest one with them on a fun day out. As they drove to the university, the little kid cheered with joy.

When they arrived, the little kid wanted to explore everywhere. He ran around and screamed with excitement!

The university students showed him all the places and got him some ice cream. He was having so much fun!

At the end of the day, the family drove home and the little kid felt so happy. He dreamed of one day going to university too.

"Look, Mommy!" exclaimed three-year-old Jenny. She had found a strange knot in the garden of her home.

"That looks strange," said Mommy.

Jenny decided to replace the knot with something else. She started looking around.

Suddenly, Jenny found a loud buzzer. She picked it up and quickly put it in the place of the knot.

Mommy shook her head, but said nothing.

Jenny smiled as the buzzer made a loud noise. But then, it wouldn't stop!

Mommy shouted, "What did you do?"

Unfortunately, the buzzer just kept getting louder and louder. Eventually, Mommy had to take it away and put the knot back in its place.

And Jenny learned her lesson - not to replace things without asking first!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy was very smart and loved to study. He always did his homework and listened to his teacher. One day, Timmy's mom made him some hot soup for lunch.

"Yum! This soup is hot," said Timmy, blowing on his spoon.

"I'm glad you like it, Timmy," said his mom. "Have you been studying for your spelling test tomorrow?"

"Yes, Mom! I've been studying every night," replied Timmy.

"That's great to hear, Timmy. Keep up the good work!" said his mom, giving him a pat on the back.

Timmy smiled and continued to enjoy his hot soup, feeling proud of himself for being a smart student.

John and his mom were at the park. John wanted to play sports, so he ran across the grass. He saw a big, deep lake.

Mom: John, don't go too close!

John stopped, but he was so excited to play sports. He wanted to look for a sport he could do. Then he saw a sport he liked.

John: Mom, look!

Mom: What is that?

John: It looks like a sport I can do there.

Mom: Okay, but stay away from the deep water.

John smiled and ran over to the sport. He had so much fun playing and running around. He even got a little wet! John had a great time playing his sport and mom was happy he stayed safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was wearing a colorful dress and her name was Lucy. She was out in the park playing with her friends, and they were all having lots of fun.

One day, they were all running around when suddenly Lucy stopped and said, "I need new clothes." All her friends asked her why, but she just shook her head.

A few days later, there was a big parade in the park, and everyone was wearing the most beautiful and colorful of clothes. Lucy saw all the amazing clothes, and wanted them too. So, she asked her mom if she could buy her some new clothes.

Her mom said, "No, Lucy. You already have plenty of clothes. We don't need any more." Lucy was so sad, but then her mom said, "Maybe next year we will buy you more clothes. Just remember, sharing is more important than having more stuff."

Lucy smiled and said, "OK". She knew that her mom was right, and that was the best lesson she could ever learn. From then on, she made sure to be a good friend and always help out by sharing her own things with her friends. In the end, she learned that one of the most important things in life is kindness and friendship.

Once there was a child named Tom. Tom was three years old. He loved visiting his friends.

One day, Tom wanted to visit his friend Kate. When he arrived at Kate's house, something was strange. The door was closed, and he could not go inside. He knocked on the door, but there was no answer.

Tom was very confused. Suddenly, Kate's mom opened the door. She said, "Oh, Tom. Kate isn't here. She had to go to the hospital for an operation."

Tom was surprised. He said, "But why?"

Kate's mom smiled. She said, "Don't worry. It is for a funny reason. She broke her arm, but it's all better now!"

Tom was relieved. He said, "That's good. Can I go visit her in the hospital?"

And that's exactly what he did. Tom visited his friend Kate in the hospital and they had a lot of fun.

One sunny day, a boy named Jack peeked out of his bedroom window. He saw the beautiful sky and it made him very happy. He quickly got dressed, grabbed a toy and ran outside.

Jack saw a cat hiding under the bush and thought it was so funny. He said to the cat, "Hi there! Come out, I won't hurt you!"

The cat didn't want to come out at first, so Jack waited patiently. Suddenly, the cat peeked out from the other side of the bush.

Jack was so happy that the cat came out to say hi. He reached down and patted the cat's back with his hand. The cat was happy too and curled up at Jack's feet.

Jack and the cat were fast friends and were happy to have each other for company. They spent the entire day playing together and had an amazing time. Jack knew he'd found a special friend that day, and he couldn't have been happier.

Once upon a time, there was a wide meadow. All different animals lived in the meadow together. They all ate the same food, played together and had peace.

One day, a little rabbit hopped through the meadow. He stopped at the edge of the meadow where there was a big tree with a swing. He hopped on it and the swing began to move.

But then, a fox came by. He saw the rabbit and opened his mouth to bite him. The rabbit was so scared!

But then the other animals noticed and together they chased the fox away. They shouted and banged their tails so the fox went away and the rabbit got off the swing and hopped into the meadow again.

The animals were very happy and enjoyed the peace of the meadow again. They all hugged and laughed.

From then on everyone in the meadow was happy, and they always remembered the fox who tried to break the peace.

Lily and Ben wanted to decorate their room for Halloween. They had many things to make it scary and fun. They had pumpkins, spiders, bats, and ghosts. They also had costumes to wear.

Lily wanted to be a witch. She had a black dress, a hat, and a broom. Ben wanted to be a superhero. He had a red suit, a cape, and a mask. They helped each other put on their costumes.

"Wow, you look incredible, Lily!" Ben said. "You are a very good witch."

"Thank you, Ben. You look incredible, too. You are a very strong superhero." Lily said.

They were ready to decorate their room. They hung the spiders and bats on the walls. They put the pumpkins and ghosts on the floor. They turned off the lights and used a flashlight to make shadows.

They were very happy with their room. They invited their mom and dad to see it. Mom and dad were very surprised and proud.

"What a spooky and fun room you have, Lily and Ben!" Mom said. "You did a great job decorating it."

"And what amazing costumes you have, Lily and Ben!" Dad said. "You are very creative and brave."

Lily and Ben smiled and hugged their mom and dad. They had a lot of fun decorating their room and dressing up for Halloween. They were very excited to go trick-or-treating later.

Lily was scared of the dark. She did not like to sleep in her room when the night came. She wanted to stay with Mom and Dad in their big bed. But Mom and Dad said she had to sleep in her own bed. They said she was a big girl now and she had to be brave.

One night, Lily heard a strange noise in her room. It sounded like a growl. She looked around and saw a big shadow on the wall. It had long teeth and claws. It was an unknown animal. Lily was very afraid. She screamed and cried.

Mom and Dad heard Lily's scream and cry. They ran to her room and turned on the light. They saw Lily hiding under her blanket. They saw the shadow on the wall. It was not an unknown animal. It was Lily's teddy bear. It had fallen from the shelf and made the noise and the shadow.

Mom and Dad hugged Lily and told her it was okay. They said it was not a real animal. It was her teddy bear. They said it was her friend and it would not hurt her. They said she could keep it in her bed if she wanted.

Lily felt better. She stopped crying. She took her teddy bear and hugged it. She said sorry to it for being scared. She said she loved it. She said good night to Mom and Dad. They said good night to her and kissed her. They turned off the light and left the room.

Lily was not scared of the dark anymore. She had her teddy bear with her. She closed her eyes and fell asleep. She dreamed of happy things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who liked to cook. She wanted to make something special for her friend who she knew was deaf.

The little girl took some butter from the fridge and put it into a frying pan. She turned on the stove and waited for the butter to melt.

When the butter was melted, the little girl took a spoon and started to stir the butter around in the pan. She smiled when she smelled the delicious smell of butter cooking.

Suddenly, her friend came into the kitchen. The little girl was excited to show her friend what she was cooking. She pointed to the pan and signalled to her friend, "I'm cooking some butter!" Her friend clapped her hands and smiled. She signalled back, "It smells yummy!"

The little girl grinned. She already knew it was going to be a delicious meal for her deaf friend!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom loved to look up at the sky every night. He would often see a comet speeding by and it would always make him happy.

One night, Tom was a bit worried because he couldn't see the comet. He asked his mom, "Mom, where is the comet? Why can't I see it?" His mom smiled warmly and said, "Don't worry, Tom. It will rise again soon."

Tom was confused. He asked, "What does that mean?" His mom explained, "It means that it will appear again. Everyone and everything has their ups and downs, just like the comet. Just be patient and it will come back to us."

Tom nodded and looked up at the night sky. He was no longer worried. He knew that everything will come back even if it seems to be gone for a while.

Tom had learned a valuable lesson from his mom: don't worry even if something is gone for a while. It will rise again.

Once upon a time, there was a nation. The people of this nation were very glad. One day, a special delivery came to the nation. It was a huge box filled with toys. Everyone was so excited and happy to get the delivery. The children ran around with the toys and played all day long, smiling and laughing. Even the grown-ups joined in the fun and laughed along with the children. The nation was very glad and everyone was having a great time. The delivery made everyone so happy that the nation was filled with joy and smiles. Everyone lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy little girl. She loved to explore different places. One day, she was at the library and saw an icicle melting. She got excited and decided to put her hands out to catch the drops of water. As the icicle melted, one drop after another went into her hands. The nosy little girl was so excited to see the liquid that she wanted to play with the melting drops all day. Suddenly, the library opened and she had to go inside. But, she took a piece of the icicle home with her. As she looked at it, she imagined the icicle melting all over her hands again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his huge drum. He would bang on it all day long and laugh when he made loud noises.

One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy saw Timmy's drum and said, "Wow, that's a big drum!" Timmy said, "Yes, it's huge! Do you want to play with it?"

Billy nodded his head and started to bang on the drum. Timmy laughed and said, "You're really good at playing the drum, Billy!" Billy smiled and said, "Thanks, Timmy. I like playing with your drum."

From that day on, Timmy and Billy played together every day. They would bang on the drum and laugh together. They were the best of friends and they loved playing music together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly man. Every day he would sit outside in his garden and watch the birds. One day, a magical fairy appeared and gave the elderly man something special - a microscope! She said it would provide him with a wonderful new experience.

The elderly man was delighted and thanked the fairy. With his new microscope he could see things he never could before. He spent all day looking into flowers, peering into plants and watching insects.

The elderly man was so excited and fascinated by all that he could see that he shared his new microscope with all his friends. His friends were amazed. One by one they looked into the special microscope and into a whole new world.

The elderly man was happy. He was glad he could provide his friends with a wonderful experience. They thanked him and continued to look into the microscope until the sun went down.

The elderly man hugged the magical fairy, who smiled, waved and disappeared into the night.

The end!

One day, Dad went to the garden to observe all of the flowers. He thought one particular flower was very beautiful. His three year old daughter followed Dad, running around, and wanted to pick the flower too.

"Please don't pick the flower," Dad said. He didn't want her to ruin the flower.

She smiled and said, "But why Dad? It looks so pretty."

"I know, but if you pick it, it won't look so pretty anymore," said Dad.

Suddenly, a crazy wind blew and picked the flower all by itself. The three year old looked in amazement, and said, "Look Dad! It's a magical flower."

Dad smiled and said, "Yes, amazing isn't it? That's why I wanted you not to pick the flower."

The little girl learned her lesson that day and knew never to pick the flowers in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a safe elephant. His name was Elly.

Elly lived in a big forest with lots of other animals. One day, Elly saw a problem in the forest. Some trees were falling down. Elly wanted to help but he didn't know how.

Then, Elly heard a voice. It was a friendly raccoon. He said, "Hi Elly! I have an idea to solve the problem."

Elly was excited. He said, "What is it?"

The raccoon said, "Let's work together. With your long trunk, you can hold up the trees while I tie them together with string. That will make them stay safe."

Elly was so happy that he had found someone to help him solve the problem. He and the raccoon worked together and in no time, the trees were safe and strong. Elly was proud of his work.

Maddy and her mom were at the store. Maddy was excited. She saw cereal boxes with fun pictures on them and felt jolly. She pointed to the box she wanted, and her mom smiled.

Maddy watched as her mom put the cereal in the cart. She shared a big smile with her mom, who smiled back.

At home, Maddy's dad had already set the table. Maddy quickly ran over to her seat and clapped her hands, ready to eat her cereal.

Her dad poured the cereal into Maddy's bowl. It was a special cereal just for Maddy. She was so excited. She smiled a big jolly smile.

Maddy and her parents spent the morning eating cereal and playing together. Everyone laughed and smiled. They had a wonderful time.

One day, a little turkey named Tim was very excited. He was going to play with his friends in the park. Tim ran to the park as fast as his little turkey legs could go.

When Tim got to the park, he saw a big dog. The dog was loud and scary. Tim started to tremble because he was scared of the big dog. He wanted to play with his friends, but the dog was in the way.

Tim's friend, a small bird named Bobby, saw that Tim was scared. Bobby said, "Don't worry, Tim. I will help you." Bobby flew over to the big dog and started to sing a pretty song. The big dog liked the song and followed Bobby away from the park.

Now Tim was not scared anymore. He stopped trembling and went to play with his friends. They all had a fun day at the park. Tim was very happy and thankful for his brave friend Bobby.

Sara and Ben liked to play with their wagon. They put their toys and books in it and pulled it around the yard. One day, they saw an elderly lady walking on the sidewalk. She had a big hat and a cane.

"Hello, children," the lady said. "What a nice wagon you have. Can I see what's inside?"

Sara and Ben nodded and ran to the lady. They showed her their toys and books. The lady smiled and said they were very good.

"Can I try your wagon?" the lady asked. "It looks like fun."

Sara and Ben agreed and helped the lady sit in the wagon. They pulled her slowly along the sidewalk. The lady laughed and waved her hat.

But then, they came to a bump. The wagon shook and the lady lost her balance. She fell out of the wagon and onto the grass.

"Ouch!" the lady said. "Are you okay?" Sara and Ben asked. They ran to the lady and helped her up.

"I'm okay, thank you," the lady said. "But I think I'm too old for wagons. Maybe you should pull each other instead."

Sara and Ben hugged the lady and said they were sorry. The lady hugged them back and said they were very kind. She gave them a candy and said goodbye. Sara and Ben waved and thanked her. Then they pulled each other in the wagon and had more fun.

Lily and Ben were playing in the tent in the backyard. They had a flashlight and some toys. They liked to pretend they were camping in the woods.

"Look, I have a bear!" Ben said, holding up a stuffed animal. "He is big and brown and soft."

"I have a bunny!" Lily said, showing her toy. "She is small and white and cute."

They hugged their toys and smiled. They turned on the flashlight and made shadows on the tent wall.

Suddenly, they heard a loud noise outside. It sounded like thunder. They saw a flash of light. It was lightning.

Lily and Ben were scared. They dropped their toys and held each other. The flashlight flickered and went out. It was dark and noisy.

"Mommy! Daddy!" they cried. "Help us!"

Their parents heard them and ran to the tent. They opened the flap and saw their children crying.

"Shh, it's okay, we're here," Mommy said, hugging them. "It's just a storm. It will pass soon."

Daddy picked up the flashlight and shook it. It didn't work.

"Sorry, kids, this flashlight is cheap. It broke," he said. "But don't worry, we have another one in the house. Come on, let's go inside and have some hot chocolate."

Lily and Ben nodded. They grabbed their toys and followed their parents. They felt better when they saw the lights and felt the warmth of the house.

They still didn't like the storm, but they knew they were safe and loved.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who had a goal. She wanted to go to the top of the mountain and see what was there. But the mountain was very high, and the path was long.

The girl began to climb and soon the sun went down. When it was dark, the girl stopped walking. She was tired and she was cold.

The girl began to weep. She was far away from her home and she was stuck. She didn't know what to do.

Then, after a while, the girl saw a light. It was coming from a big house at the top of the mountain. The girl walked towards the house and when she got there, she saw a kind woman. She gave the girl some food to eat and a warm bed to sleep in.

The kind woman said, "You can stay here tonight and then tomorrow you can keep climbing and reach your goal".

From that day, the girl never stopped believing in her goal. She kept climbing and she eventually reached the top of the mountain. And there, she saw the most beautiful view.

She was glad she stayed strong and never gave up. She was proud of her long journey and all she had accomplished.

Once upon a time there was a small boy named Bob. Bob was excited because he had a new toy. The toy was a pretend truck.

Bob was so excited to play with his new toy that he wanted to take it straight to the park. He quickly grabbed his toy truck and ran outside.

At the park, Bob saw a girl playing with a pretend doll. Bob was so excited that he asked the girl if he could join her.

The girl smiled and said, "No, this is my pretend game. You need your own toy to play."

Bob was sad. He didn't want to play alone, but he also didn't want to share his new toy. Bob sat and thought for a few minutes and then he had an idea.

He ran home, grabbed his toy truck, and then ran back to the park. When he arrived, he asked the girl if she wanted to play pretend together. She said yes, and the two of them were excited to start playing together. They laughed and had so much fun together!

Once there was a little girl named Tess. Tess was three years old and loved playing with her friends. One day they decided to play hockey outside. Tess was excited to play and grabbed her stick.

As they started playing, Tess noticed that her friends were ignoring her. She didn't understand why and felt very sad. She tried to talk to them, but they just continued to ignore her. Tess felt a bit teary.

Fortunately, Tess's mum saw what was happening. She came out of the house, gave Tess a big hug and said, "Don't worry Tess, let's play a mild game of hockey together".

Tess smiled, and felt better. She and her mum played together in the mild sunshine and soon Tess's friends were playing with them too. Tess had a wonderful time, and from then on her friends were much nicer.

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play in the park every day. They liked to swing, slide and run. They also liked to talk to the birds and the squirrels.

One day, they saw a big, black dog in the park. The dog looked playful. He wagged his tail and ran towards them. Lily and Ben were not afraid. They liked dogs.

"Hello, doggy!" Lily said. "What is your name?"

The dog did not reply. He jumped on Lily and licked her face. Lily giggled.

"Stop, doggy!" Ben said. "You are too rough!"

The dog did not reply. He jumped on Ben and licked his face. Ben laughed.

"Let's play, doggy!" Lily said. "You can be our friend!"

The dog did not reply. He ran away with Lily's shoe in his mouth. Lily and Ben chased him.

"Come back, doggy!" Ben said. "That is Lily's shoe!"

The dog did not reply. He dropped the shoe and ran to a man. The man was the dog's owner. He was looking for him.

"Sorry, kids!" the man said. "This is Rex. He is very playful, but he does not listen well. He likes to take things that are not his."

Lily and Ben got the shoe back. They were not angry. They liked Rex.

"It's okay, mister!" Lily said. "Rex is fun. Can we play with him again?"

The man smiled. He replied, "Sure, kids. You can play with Rex anytime. He likes you too."

Lily and Ben were happy. They had a new friend. They played with Rex until it was time to go home. They waved goodbye to Rex and the man. They hoped to see them again.

Once upon a time, there was a blue bird named Bobby. Bobby liked to fly high in the sky. One day, while he was flying, he saw a big cloud. The cloud was white and fluffy, just like cotton.

Bobby wanted to play with the cloud, so he flew closer. As he got near, he saw a little girl named Lily. Lily was sitting on the cloud, laughing and clapping her hands. "Hi Bobby!" she said. "Do you want to play with me on the cloud?"

Bobby nodded his head and tried to land on the cloud. But it was so soft and slippery that he couldn't stay on it. Bobby started to slip and slide all over the cloud, and Lily laughed. "Don't worry, Bobby," she said. "I'll help you."

Lily held out her hand, and Bobby grabbed it. Together, they played on the cloud, laughing and having fun. After a while, the sun began to set, and Bobby had to fly home. He said goodbye to Lily, and they promised to play on the cloud again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim and his mom went to the store. They wanted to buy a toy. Tim saw a toy car. It was blue and icy. Tim liked the icy toy car. He asked his mom, "Can I have the car?" His mom looked at the price. The price was low. She said, "Yes, you can have the car."

When they got home, Tim was very happy. He wanted to play with his new toy car. He asked his mom, "Can I unpack the car now?" His mom said, "Yes, you can unpack the car." Tim unpacked the car. He played with it all day.

At night, Tim put his icy toy car next to his bed. He said goodnight to his mom. He was very happy with his new toy. Tim went to sleep with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Bobo. Bobo was always ready to play and have fun. One day, he saw a big step in the park. He thought it would be fun to jump on it.

Bobo tried to settle near the step, but he was too excited. He ran around and around, not paying attention to where he was going. He didn't see the big hole near the step.

Bobo kept playing near the step, not knowing about the hole. He was so happy and ready to jump. But then, Bobo fell into the hole. He couldn't get out and he was very sad. The fun day at the park had a bad ending for poor Bobo.

Tom is a dog who likes to play with his bone. He has a big bone that he found in the park. He thinks it is the best bone ever. He carries it everywhere and chews on it all day.

One day, Tom sees a new dog in the park. The new dog is big and fluffy and has a shiny collar. Tom thinks the new dog is very pretty. He wants to be friends with her. He runs to her and says, "Hi, I am Tom. Do you want to play with me and my bone?"

The new dog looks at Tom and his bone. She sniffs them and says, "No, thank you. Your bone is old and dirty. And you are small and ordinary. I only play with dogs who have new and shiny bones. And who are big and special. Go away, Tom. You are boring."

Tom feels sad and hurt. He does not understand why the new dog is so mean. He likes his bone and he thinks he is a good dog. He does not want to go away. He wants to play and have fun.

But the new dog ignores him. She turns her back on him and walks away. She does not care about Tom or his feelings. She only cares about herself and her looks.

Tom decides that the new dog is not a nice dog. He does not want to be friends with her anymore. He goes back to his bone and chews on it happily. He thinks his bone is the best bone ever. And he is a good dog. He hopes to find other dogs who are kind and friendly. And who like to play with him and his bone.

Once there was a nice girl named Jane who liked to play. She was very adventurous and liked to explore.
One day, Jane decided to take a step into the living room. She saw a nice chair in the corner of the room and was very excited.
She carefully stepped over to the chair and slowly sat down on it. She leaned back and smiled as she felt the gentle cushions beneath her.
Jane looked around the room and saw all the different things to explore. She liked the chair so much that she decided to stay and play there for a while.
And so Jane happily stepped off of the nice chair and continued exploring the living room.

Timmy was playing in the park one day when he saw a modern toilet. His eyes lit up with excitement and he ran towards it. But when he went to open the door he found it was locked. Timmy started to cry. Then he heard a voice from inside the toilet. It was an old grumpy man.

The man said, "What are you doing here? I'm trying to get some peace and quiet and you're making a racket. Go away and play elsewhere."

Timmy looked up at the man with sad eyes and said, "Please, can I just have a look? It looks so modern and exciting."

The old grumpy man sighed and said, "All right. Come in but just have a quick look."

Timmy looked around the toilet in awe and he was very excited to have seen such a modern place. Then he went to the park to play some more with a smile on his face.

One day, a bird wanted to fly high in the sky. The bird was very serious about flying. He flapped his wings and flew up, up, up!

As the bird flew, he saw a point far away. He wanted to go to the point. He thought, "I can fly there!" So, he flew and flew until he got close to the point.

When he got to the point, he saw a little bug. The bug said, "Hello, bird! Did you fly here?" The bird said, "Yes, I did! I flew very high to get here." The bug and the bird became friends, and they played together at the point.

Lily and Ben are playing with their toys. They have many things to play with: cars, dolls, blocks, and puzzles. Lily likes puzzles. She likes to match the pieces that have the same shape and color. Ben likes cars. He likes to make them go fast and make noises.

"Look, Lily, I have a red car and a blue car. They are very fast and loud. Vroom, vroom!" Ben says.

"Look, Ben, I have a puzzle with animals. They are very cute and quiet. See, this is a cat and this is a dog. They match!" Lily says.

They show each other their toys and smile. They are happy to play together.

But then, the wind blows and the door opens. A cold air comes in. Lily and Ben shiver. They feel cold.

"Brrr, it is cold. I don't like cold. Do you, Lily?" Ben asks.

"No, I don't like cold either. Let's close the door and get a blanket. Then we can play more." Lily says.

They run to the door and close it. They find a big blanket and wrap it around them. They feel warm and cozy. They go back to their toys and play more. They match their puzzles and race their cars. They have fun. They are happy.

Once there was a powerful lock. It was so strong that nothing could unlock it. Not even the strongest of animals or humans could open the lock.

One day, a 3-year-old boy and his grandpa were walking in the forest. Suddenly, the boy saw the lock. He was very curious, and asked his grandpa, "What is that?". His grandpa replied, "That's a lock. It's very powerful and nothing can open it."

The boy didn't agree. "I think I can open it", he said. His grandpa laughed, and said, "No, son. That's impossible."

The boy kept trying, and trying. He was determined to open the lock. Finally, after much effort, he was able to open it. He gave a big smile and said, "See grandpa, I knew I could do it!"

Anna liked to play with her cute doll. She named her doll Lily and gave her a pink dress and a hat. Anna and Lily did everything together. They had tea parties, read books, and sang songs.

One day, Anna and Lily went to the park with Mommy. Anna saw a big slide and wanted to try it. She put Lily on the grass and ran to the slide. She climbed up the ladder and slid down with a big smile. She felt happy and proud.

But when she went back to the grass, Lily was gone. Anna looked everywhere, but she could not find her doll. She felt sad and scared. She started to cry and called for Mommy.

Mommy came and hugged Anna. She asked her what was wrong. Anna told her that Lily disappeared. Mommy helped Anna look for Lily. They searched the park, but they could not see her.

Then, Mommy noticed a small crack in the fence. She peeked through the crack and saw Lily on the other side. She was lying on the dirt, next to a trash can. Mommy reached through the crack and grabbed Lily. She gave her back to Anna.

Anna was so happy to see Lily. She hugged her and kissed her. She thanked Mommy for finding her. She said she was sorry for leaving her alone. She promised to never lose her again.

Mommy smiled and said it was okay. She said she was glad they found Lily. She said they should go home and wash her. She said Lily was a very cute doll. Anna agreed and nodded. She held Lily tight and walked with Mommy. She felt happy and safe.

Once there was an enormous hook. The hook was so big it seemed to reach up to the sky. Every day the hook stayed in the same place. It was very quiet.
One night, the hook started to move. It began to swing around and around, faster and faster. It moved so quickly it began to glow brightly.
The hook started to take the shape of an enormous bird. The bird was so big that it filled the sky. It glided slowly over the hills.
Every day the bird stayed in the same place, soaring in the sky. It was very peaceful. Eventually the bird changed shape and returned to the same spot- an enormous hook.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Molly. Molly had a great big, hairy dog. They were very happy together.

One day, Molly and her dog were out walking in the park when they heard a noise. Molly was scared and she hugged her dog tight. Then something strange happened. A ghost appeared beneath a tree. It was a very strange sight.

Molly's dog growled at the ghost. The ghost ran away and Molly felt brave.

"What was that, Molly?" asked her dog.

"I don't know," replied Molly.

As they continued their walk, Molly noticed something strange. Whenever Molly said the word "yield", ghosts appeared from the trees! She had the magic power to make ghosts yield.

Molly was excited and scared at the same time. She decided to keep this magic to herself. Molly went home and hugged her hairy dog. She knew she was safe.

One day, a grumpy cat named Tom found a big motorcycle in the park. He wanted to ride it, but he was too small. Tom saw his friend, a little bird named Tim, sitting on a tree branch.

"Tim, can you help me ride the motorcycle?" asked Tom.

Tim thought for a moment and said, "Yes, I have an idea! Let's cut a long stick to help you reach the buttons."

So, Tom and Tim worked together. They found a big stick and cut it to make it the right size. Tom used the stick to press the buttons on the motorcycle. Vroom! The motorcycle started moving.

Tom was so happy riding the motorcycle with Tim flying next to him. They had a fun day at the park, and Tom was not grumpy anymore.

Once upon a time there was a rabbit who was weak and always very hungry. He asked, "What food is there for me to eat?" He looked around and saw a turnip. He hopped over to the turnip and tried to pull it from the ground but he was too weak.

Suddenly, a friendly goat appeared. The goat said, â€œLet me help you!â€ The goat began to reverse around the turnip, like a windmill, and eventually he was able to pull the turnip from the ground.

The rabbit thanked the goat and said, â€œI need to eat this turnip. It is the only food I have!â€ Little did he know, the goat had a snack in his pocket - a delicious carrot - but he decided not to share it. Poor rabbit!

The bunny sadly hopped away with the turnip in his mouth. He never got to eat the tasty food he wanted and he stayed very weak! The end.

Sara and Tom are playing in the kitchen. They see many dishes on the table. Some dishes are clean and some dishes are dirty. Sara wants to help mom and dad. She picks up a clean dish and puts it in the cupboard.

"Good job, Sara!" Tom says. He points to a dirty dish. "Can I help too?"

Sara nods. "Yes, you can. But be careful. The dirty dish is wet and slippery. You have to hold it with both hands."

Tom tries to hold the dirty dish with both hands. But he is not careful. He drops the dirty dish on the floor. It breaks into many pieces. Tom is scared. He starts to cry.

"Oh no, Tom!" Sara says. She runs to him and hugs him. "It's okay. It was an accident. Don't cry."

Mom and dad hear the noise. They come to the kitchen. They see the broken dish and the crying Tom. They are not angry. They are kind.

"What happened here?" mom asks.

"Sara and I wanted to help. But I dropped the dirty dish. I'm sorry." Tom says.

"It's okay, Tom. We know you wanted to help. Thank you for trying. But next time, please ask us first. We don't want you to get hurt." dad says.

He picks up Tom and kisses him. Mom picks up Sara and kisses her. They clean up the mess together. They tell Sara and Tom that they love them. Sara and Tom are happy. They love mom and dad too.

One day, Daisy went to the subway with her mom and dad. She saw a lot of people running around. Daisy asked why they were running. Her mom told her that they were late to catch the subway. Daisy thought it was exciting to run to catch the subway.

But then, Daisy heard a bad noise coming from the subway. All the people stopped running and got very scared. Daisy saw some fire coming out of the subway. Her mom and dad told her to run away. So Daisy, her mom and dad ran very far away.

When Daisy was safe, her mom and dad told her to never run towards a bad subway again. Later, Daisy saw a nice, clean subway and thought it looked fun. Her mom and dad said it was okay for Daisy to run towards a nice, clean subway. Daisy had a great time running to the subway and back again.

Sara and Tom are twins. They like to visit their grandpa. He is a great man. He has a big house with a garden. He tells them stories and plays with them.

One day, they go to visit grandpa with their mom. They knock on the door. Grandpa opens it and smiles. He hugs them and says, "Hello, my little ones. I'm so happy to see you. Come in, come in."

They go inside and see a big cake on the table. It has candles and frosting. Grandpa says, "It's my birthday today. I made a cake for us. Do you want some?"

Sara and Tom clap their hands and say, "Yes, please. Happy birthday, grandpa. We love you."

They sit down and eat the cake. It is yummy. They sing a song for grandpa. He blows out the candles and makes a wish. He says, "My wish is to have more days like this. You are the best gift I ever had."

Sara and Tom hug him and say, "You are the best grandpa ever. We are glad you are our grandpa."

They spend the afternoon playing and talking. They have a lot of fun. They are happy to visit their grandpa. He is a great man.

Once there was a very stubborn dog called Steven. He didn't like following the rules and always wanted to do things his way. One day, Steven decided he wanted to marry the big building next door.

He asked the building, "Will you marry me?"
The building looked at him and said, "No way!"

Steve was so disappointed and he didn't know what to do. But he was determined to marry the building and refused to give up.

He went to the building every day and asked it to marry him. After months of asking, the building finally said yes! On their wedding day, Steven was so happy and all his friends were there to celebrate with him.

He looked up to the building and said, "We did it! We got married!" Steven hugged the building and the whole neighbourhood cheered. They were all so happy for Steven and his new bride, the building.

Once upon a time there was a cute little girl named Daisy. Daisy had a glove that she liked to play with. She used to mix everything with it. She mixed sand and dirt and even food. One day, Daisy tried to mix mud and water with her glove. It didn't work very well, because it was too sloppy. Daisy got mad and threw the glove into the mud. She started to cry, because it was her favorite glove.

But then something amazing happened! A little frog hopped out of the mud and gave her the glove back. It was all cleaned off and looked like new. Daisy was so happy! She hugged the frog and thanked him for cleaning her glove.

And from then on, Daisy was always careful when she mixed things with her glove. She always made sure it was clean, and she still plays with it today.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lina. Lina wanted to be very wealthy when she grew up, but she didn't know how to get there. She asked her parents for advice and they told her that if she tried hard enough, she could succeed.

Lina practiced and practiced to make the best of her gifts. She worked hard and eventually became very good at what she did. People told her that she had a special talent.

Soon she was able to make money doing something she enjoyed and started to become wealthy. She was very proud of the way she had used her talents to succeed.

Lina was now a very wealthy young woman. She wanted to use her wealth and gifts to help others. She started a charity to help others and became a well of knowledge and help to those who needed it.

From then on, Lina was always successful in all of her ventures. She knew that if she worked hard and used her talents, she could succeed and become wealthy.

Once there was a little girl named Lola. She was very excited one day because it had just started to snow. She put on her warm coat and went outside to see it. The snow was so white and soft that it made her giggle with joy.

She made a snowball and threw it at her dad who was standing nearby. He dodged the snowball and said "Let's make a snowman!" With that, they both ran around trying to find twigs and stones for its eyes and mouth.

After they had found all the pieces, Lola's dad put them onto the big mound of snow. When he was standing back up, the snowman began to come to life. Lola was so nervous, but the snowman just smiled at them and said "Hello! What is your name?"

Lola looked up at her dad and he said "Lola, you are safe. He is a friendly snowman."

Lola smiled at the snowman and said her name. The snowman smiled back and said his name was Frosty. He said that if they yielded over to the nearby hill he would show them something special.

Lola and her dad followed Frosty to the top of the hill. When they got there they saw the most beautiful view of the sun setting over the snow-covered fields. Frosty said "I hope you like this view."

Lola smiled and said "It

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a magic lamp. The lamp was very special. It could grow big and small. Mia loved her lamp very much.

One day, a foolish boy named Tom saw Mia's lamp. He wanted the lamp for himself. Tom tried to take the lamp away from Mia. Mia was sad and asked Tom to give her lamp back.

Tom saw how much Mia loved her lamp. He felt bad for being foolish. Tom gave the lamp back to Mia. Mia was happy again. The lamp grew big and bright. Mia and Tom became friends and played together every day.

Lily and Tom were friends who liked to play with loops. Loops were round things that you could roll, spin, or wear. They had many loops of different colors and sizes. One day, they received a big box from their aunt. Inside the box, there were many new loops that they had never seen before.

"Wow, look at these loops!" Lily said. "They are so shiny and pretty. Can we play with them?"

"Of course we can!" Tom said. "Let's see what they can do."

They opened the box and took out the loops. Some of the loops had bells, some had beads, some had ribbons, and some had lights. They tried to roll, spin, and wear the loops, but they did not work well. The bells made too much noise, the beads fell off, the ribbons got tangled, and the lights hurt their eyes.

"These loops are not fun," Lily said. "They are too different from our old loops. I want to play with our old loops."

"Me too," Tom said. "Let's put these loops back in the box and play with our old loops."

They put the new loops back in the box and went to look for their old loops. But they could not find them. They looked everywhere, but they were gone.

"Where are our old loops?" Lily asked. "Did someone take them?"

"Maybe the aunt took them," Tom said. "Maybe she wanted to trade them for the new loops."

"That's not fair!" Lily said. "We did not want to trade our old loops. We liked our old loops. They were our favorite loops."

They started to cry. They wished they had not opened the box. They wished they had not played with the new loops. They wished they had kept their old loops.

The moral of the story is: Be careful what you wish for. Sometimes, the things that seem new and exciting are not as good as the things that you already have. You should appreciate what you have and not be greedy for what you don't.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat limes. He thought limes were the perfect fruit. They were green and round, and they tasted so good. Tim's mom always told him to behave when he ate his limes.

One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He brought a lime with him. While he was playing, he met a girl named Sue. Sue saw the lime and asked, "What is that?"

"This is a lime," Tim said. "It's the perfect fruit. Do you want to try some?"

Sue tried the lime and liked it too. They both behaved and shared the lime. They became good friends and always played together at the park. And from that day on, they both loved limes and always behaved when they ate them.

Once upon a time there was a bad man. He wore a cap that made him look mean! Everyone was scared of him.

One day, two brave friends decided to try and escape the mean man. They were so brave! They ran really fast until they were out of sight. Amazingly, they escaped!

The friends were so happy. They ran back to their home and shared the amazing story with their family and friends. Everyone was so relieved that the friends had escaped from the mean man.

The bad man did not give up easily. He tried to find the friends again but they were too fast and too clever. Then, one day, he forgot all about them and went off in search of other adventures.

The friends were so glad to be safe. They were so proud of themselves for escaping the bad man and his mean old cap. They were happy to be free forever!

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the park. She liked to play on the swings and slide. As she played, she saw a big dog. The dog was very friendly and came to say hello.

Lily said, "Hi dog! Do you want to play with me?" The dog wagged its tail, showing it was happy. They played together for a while, running and laughing. But then, Lily accidentally stepped on the dog's toe.

"Ouch!" cried the dog. Lily felt bad and said, "I'm sorry, dog. I didn't mean to hurt you." The dog looked at her and said, "It's okay, Lily. Just be careful next time."

Lily wanted to make the dog feel better, so she gave it a gentle slap on its back, like a pat. The dog wagged its tail and they continued to play. They played until the sun went down and it was time to go home. Lily knew she had made a new friend and they would play together whenever they were both available at the park.

Once there was a boy called Sam. He was three years old. Sam wanted to go outside and play. So, he went to the park yesterday. He saw a big rock there. Sam wanted to rock the rock. He pushed the rock with all his strength. The rock rocked back and forth!

Sam was happy and laughed. He was so happy, he ran around the rock. Then, he found something bitter. It was a berry that was not ripe. He made a sour face because it was so bitter.

But then, he remembered that he was still rocking the rock! So, he went back to the rock and rocked it some more. It rocked back and forth like before. Sam was so happy! He smiled and said, "Rock! Rock!"

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy was walking through the forest when he stumbled on a rock. He fell down and hurt his knee.

Suddenly, there was a big boom in the sky. Timmy looked up and saw lightning! He got scared and started to cry.

But then, his mom came running over. She was very careful not to trip on any rocks. She picked Timmy up and hugged him tight. She told him not to be afraid of the lightning because it was far away.

Timmy felt much better and his mom carried him all the way home. He was happy to be safe and sound with his mom. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a old man. He had an ancient car. The car was very special to him.

One day, a little girl was walking by the old man's house. She saw the old man's car and wanted to play with it. She asked the old man if she could use his car. The old man said yes.

The little girl enjoyed playing with the old car. She moved it around and pretended to drive it.

Eventually, the little girl had to go home. She asked the old man if she could keep the car. But the old man said no. He thanked the little girl for playing with his car, but reminded her that she should only lend things that belong to her.

The little girl understood and thanked the old man. She learned an important lesson that day - we should only lend things that belong to us.

Once upon a time there was a thin magic print. It was so special that it could make anything appear! Everyone was amazed.

One day, a 3-year-old boy named Jack was playing in the park. He saw the print and ran over to look at it. He was so excited. He asked his mom, "What's that?"

"That's a magic print," his mom said.

Jack was so happy. He wanted to try the print, so he reached out and put his hand on it. Suddenly, a beautiful castle appeared! Jack was so excited. He ran around and around the castle, laughing and having fun.

Then, he looked at his mom and said, "Thank you, Mommy! This is the best thing ever!"

Once there was a little girl. She loved to play outside with her scooter. Every day she would pick it up and ride around the yard. She liked to pretend she was a big racer.

But one day, something happened. When the little girl was riding her scooter, she heard a scary noise! She was scared, but she kept going. Then she saw something even more scary - a big monster!

The little girl was so scared she dropped her scooter and ran away as fast as she could. She ran all the way home and she never picked up the scooter again. She was too scared to go back.

But the really amazing thing happened later that day. The monster was gone. In its place was a kind old lady! She gave the little girl a big hug and said, "Don't be scared. You can pick up your scooter anytime you want."

The little girl smiled and thanked the old lady. From then on, she was no longer scared to ride her scooter. She picked it up and went riding every day!

Once upon a time there was a panda who was very rich. She had lots of money and a nice big home to live in. But she was feeling sad. She was lonely and sad because she was living all by herself.

One day, while she was sad and alone, a kind bear came to her home. He wanted to help the panda, and said that he would protect her and keep her safe. He spent all of his time playing with her and helping her feel better.

They became good friends and the bear kept coming back every day. He always made sure the panda was happy and safe. Every night, he slept near the panda and kept her safe from all the scary things.

They eventually became very close and the panda was no longer lonely or sad. She never had to worry about anything because she knew her bear friend was always there to protect her.

Once upon a time, there was a kid named Timmy. He loved to play games with his friends, but sometimes he got very competitive. He wanted to win every game they played.

One day, Timmy's friends wanted to play a game of tag. Timmy was excited and wanted to be "it". But when he was "it", he found it hard to catch his friends. They were all running very fast and it was making Timmy frustrated.

But Timmy remembered something his mom had told him. She said that sometimes it's important to resist the urge to win and just have fun with your friends. So, Timmy decided to stop being so competitive and just enjoy playing tag with his friends. And you know what? He had so much fun!

It was a sunny day and Jimmy was out playing in the park. As he ran around, he came across a mouse. He was excited to see it and noticed how flexible the little mouse was.

Jimmy exclaimed, â€œWow, that mouse is so flexible! Maybe it wants to be my friend!â€

The mouse gave him a little surprise, by hopping right up on his shoulder! Jimmy was overjoyed and thought to himself, â€œNow I have a new best friend!â€

Jimmy and the mouse were having so much fun running around the park together, but then suddenly they heard someone coming towards them. It was Jimmyâ€™s mom. She had come to take him home.
