Suddenly she felt a sharp pain in her ankle. She started to cry. She wanted to go back inside but the pain was too strong. She sat down and cried.

Just then, a yellow bird came to sit on a tree next to her. The bird started to chirp and flew around her. This made Julie stop crying. She looked up at the bird and smiled.

The bird flew away but Julie wasn't sad anymore. She slowly walked back inside, trying to complete her game of ball. When she got back, her mom hugged her and kissed her pain away. Everything was complete again.

There was a little girl with dark hair. Her name was Joy. She lived in a big house with her parents. One day, Joy was playing outside in her garden. Suddenly, she felt something on her leg - something pinching her. It was a big, black bug!

Joy screamed and tried to get away, but the bug kept following her. She tried to run and hide, but it was too quick.

Joy's parents heard her cries and came running. They used a stick to help her get rid of the bug. After the bug was gone, they hugged Joy and told her everything would be alright.

When the bug was gone, Joy felt relieved and happy. She went back to playing in the garden, making sure she didn't step on any more bugs.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy neighbor who always slept all day. He never helped anyone in the village. One day, a kind little girl asked him to help her carry some heavy boxes, but he just said "no" and went back to sleep.

The little girl was sad, but she didn't give up. She decided to ask her other neighbors for help. They all said "yes" and helped her with the boxes. When the lazy neighbor saw how happy the little girl was, he felt bad. He realized that he should have helped her too.

From that day on, the lazy neighbor started to help people in the village. He learned that it feels good to help others and be a good neighbor. And the little girl learned that it's important to ask for help from those who are willing to bow down and help.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to the zoo with her mom and dad. She liked to see all the different animals, but her favorite was the tiger. She wanted to get closer to the big cat, but her mom said no.

"Too dangerous, Mia. The tiger might hurt you. Stay with us, please."

But Mia was curious and brave. She saw a small hole in the fence and crawled through it. She ran towards the tiger's cage, hoping to see its stripes and whiskers. She did not see the sign that said "Do not feed the animals".

The tiger saw Mia and growled. He was hungry and angry. He did not like people coming into his space. He jumped at the cage, trying to reach Mia. Mia was scared and screamed. She dropped her bag of popcorn on the ground.

The tiger smelled the popcorn and stopped growling. He liked popcorn. He licked his lips and pawed at the cage, wanting to get some. Mia saw that the tiger was not mean, just hungry. She felt sorry for him. She picked up some popcorn and threw it to the tiger. The tiger ate it and purred. He looked at Mia with his big yellow eyes and smiled.

"Thank you, little girl. You are compassionate. You share your food with me. You are my friend."

Mia smiled back. She was happy that the tiger was happy. She wanted to play with him, but she heard her mom and dad calling her name. They were worried and angry. They had seen her go through the hole and run to the tiger. They came to get her and take her back to safety.

"Mia, what were you thinking? You could have been hurt by the tiger. He is a wild animal, not a pet. You were very naughty. We are going home now."

Mia was sad. She did not want to leave the tiger. She waved goodbye to him and said sorry.

"Bye, tiger. I'm sorry I made you mad. You are my friend. I hope you get more popcorn."

The tiger waved back and said thank you.

"Bye, little girl. I'm sorry I scared you. You are my friend. I hope you come back soon."

Jim was the bravest astronaut! He was the first one to record a moonwalk. He put on his spacesuit, adjusted his helmet and took a giant step out of the spaceship. As he floated in the air, he could see the Earth, twinkling in the night sky.

Jim took in a deep breath. He had oxygen in his suit, so he wasn't worried. He extended his arm and waved. It was a fierce moment! He shouted "Hello, Earth!"

Back on the spaceship, his crew were cheering and recording the moment. They were so proud of their brave friend! Jim smiled and waved to them one more time before floating back to the spaceship.

Jim exclaimed "That was awesome! I can't believe I recorded a moonwalk!"

His crew nodded in agreement and looked at their brave friend with admiration. Jim had done it! He had recorded a brave moonwalk and made history.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was very brave, but sometimes she was a bit anxious. One day, Sarah decided to go to the theater. She had never been to a theater before, so she was extra anxious.

When Sarah arrived, she noticed that the theater was a bit cold. She began to shiver a bit. Suddenly, a kind theater worker saw Sarah. She gave Sarah a cozy blanket so she would not be cold. Even with the blanket, Sarah was still a bit afraid. But soon enough, Sarah's fear faded away and she was able to enjoy the show!

One day, a boy went to visit a king. The king was very big and wore a gold hat. The king was troubled because he lost his favorite toy.

The boy said, "King, don't be sad. I will help you find your toy." They looked in the big room and the small room. They looked under the bed and in the toy box.

At last, they found the toy behind a big chair. The king was very happy. He said, "Thank you, boy! You are a good friend." And they played with the toy together.

Once upon a time, there was a tall lion. He lived in a big jungle with other animals. One day, the lion wanted to show off his strength.

He jumped as high as he could and then he landed on a tree. He thought he was very brave, but the tree broke!

The lion was not happy. He wanted to find something else to break and show how brave he was. But, he looked around and all he could find were other animals.

He couldn't break them, so the lion just sat down and smelled the flowers instead. The other animals were happy that the lion didn't break anything else.

Once there was a little girl called Daisy. She was three years old and loved to explore. One day she was on an adventure in the park. She noticed an old camera lying on the ground next to a tree. She picked it up and decided to take it home.

When Daisy arrived home with the camera, her mummy was very surprised. She asked Daisy where she got it from. Daisy told her mummy about the park and the old camera.

Mummy thought the camera was broken but then she found a battery and put it into the camera. To her delight, the camera worked!

Mummy was very grateful to Daisy. She said "the camera fits in perfectly with Daisy's adventure kit. Now you can take photos of all your adventures."

Daisy was very happy and thanked her mummy. She was very excited to go back to the park and go on many more adventures with her camera.

Lily and Max were twins who liked to play together. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big vase that their mom gave them. The vase was blue and shiny, and it had flowers on it. Lily and Max liked to pretend that the vase was a castle, a spaceship, or a hat.

One day, they had a fight over the vase. Lily wanted to use it as a castle, and Max wanted to use it as a spaceship. They both pulled the vase, and it broke into two pieces. They were very sad and angry, and they blamed each other.

"Give me the vase, it's mine!" Lily shouted.

"No, it's mine, you broke it!" Max yelled.

They stopped playing and went to their rooms. They did not talk to each other for a long time.

Their mom saw what happened and felt sorry for them. She knew they loved the vase, and she wanted them to be friends again. She had an idea. She glued the vase back together, and put a sticker on it that said "Lily and Max". She brought the vase to their rooms and knocked on their doors.

"Look what I have for you," she said. "It's your vase, and it's fixed. But there is something new on it. Can you see it?"

Lily and Max opened their doors and saw the vase. They were surprised and happy. They saw the sticker with their names, and they smiled.

"It's our vase, and it's beautiful," Lily said.

"Yes, it's our vase, and it's special," Max said.

They hugged their mom and thanked her. Then they hugged each other and said they were sorry. They decided to share the vase and play together again. They were friendly and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a happy hippo. He loved to play and eat grass. One day, he met a sad monkey who had lost his banana. The hippo wanted to help the monkey, so he designed a plan. He asked his friends, the birds, to search for the missing banana.

After a while, the birds found the banana and brought it back to the monkey. The monkey was so happy and cheerful that he thanked the hippo and his bird friends. The hippo felt proud of himself for helping the monkey.

The moral of the story is that helping others can make us feel good and happy too.

Timmy saw a hole in the ground and asked his Mommy what was in it. She told him she was going to bury something in it, so Timmy asked what it was.

"It's a shield," Mommy said, "and I'm going to bury it so it stays safe for as long as possible."

"Why do you want to bury it?" Timmy asked.

"Because I'm worried it might get lost or stolen," Mommy said.

Timmy helped Mommy bury the shield. They put it in the hole and covered it with dirt and then patted the dirt down with their hands.

When they were done Timmy asked if the shield would be safe now.

"Yes," Mommy said, smiling, "now the shield is safe and sound."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her backyard. One day, her friend Timmy came over to play with her.

"Hi Lily! What are we going to do today?" asked Timmy.

Lily said, "Let's play hide-and-seek! We can include my little brother too."

Timmy agreed and they started to play. Lily's little brother was hiding behind a big brown tree. Timmy found him and said, "You're it!"

After the game, they all sat down to have a snack. Lily's mom brought out some juicy limes for them to eat. Timmy said, "These limes are sour!" But Lily liked them because they were green and tasty.

They all had a great time playing together and eating limes. Lily was happy to have such good friends.

Once upon a time there was a young girl who lived in a small house. One day she decided to go for a walk in the woods near her house. While she was walking, she saw a small door in the ground. She used all her strength to push it open and saw some stairs that led up to an attic.

She went up the stairs and when she entered the attic, she saw someone. He was dressed in all black and he looked like he was in a hurry. He spoke to the young girl, "You should not be here. Hurry, go back the way you came".

The young girl was scared and she quickly ran back the way she had come. But before she could get very far away, the man chasing her appeared. He was coming closer and closer.

The young girl started to cry and she ran faster, but she couldn't outrun the man. He quickly caught up to her and grabbed her.

The young girl was never seen again.

Ernie was playing in his room when he heard a terrible noise coming from outside. He stepped outside to investigate and he saw that his dad was out in the garden involved in a big project. Ernie was very curious, so he asked his dad what he was doing. His dad said he was making something with a hammer. Ernie was so excited and asked if he could help.

His dad let him try hammering for a few minutes, but it was too difficult for him. After a few attempts Ernie dropped the hammer and it made a terrible noise. His dad was mad because the hammer was broken. He said Ernie was too young to help and sent him back inside.

Ernie was sad and confused. He had been so careful, why was his dad so mad? Suddenly Ernie realized what had happened; he had made a terrible mess! Ernie was embarrassed and he knew he had to fix it, but he didn't know how. He was really scared and he began to cry.

Ernie's dad quickly came to his side and hugged him tight. He said that it was okay and he understood why the hammer broke. He said a real hammer was much too heavy for Ernie. Then his dad went back outside and got a special toy hammer for Ernie. They spent the rest of the afternoon making things together, and it was a lot of fun.

One day Bob decided to perform an experiment. He opened a small chamber and examined what was inside. To his surprise, he found lots of broken bits lying inside. Using these broken pieces, Bob decided to perform a test. He put the broken bits and pieces together and, slowly but surely, he began to put them back together again. After several attempts, Bob was pleased to discover a perfect functioning chamber! Bob was so proud of his work that he showed it off to his friends. They were amazed by his clever experiment!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and his favorite toy was a red car. One day, Timmy's friend came over to play.

"Wow, I like your car! Can I play with it?" asked Timmy's friend.

"Yes, you can play with it. But please be careful with it because it's my own car," replied Timmy.

Timmy's friend was very happy and played with the car for a while. Suddenly, he saw a flag on the floor. "Look, Timmy! What is this flag for?" he asked.

"That's my dad's flag. He is a dependable soldier and he always carries it with him," Timmy explained.

Timmy and his friend played together for a long time and had a lot of fun. When it was time for his friend to go home, Timmy said, "Thank you for playing with me and taking care of my own car. Let's play again soon!"

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia liked to play dress up with her clothes. She would put on pretty dresses and skirts. She liked to reveal her fashion to her friends. Her friends liked her fashion too. They would clap and say, "Wow, Mia! You look so nice!"

One day, Mia found a dirty, old dress in her closet. It was disgusting! It had mud and yucky stuff on it. Mia did not want to wear the disgusting dress. But she had an idea. She would clean the dress and make it pretty again.

Mia washed the dress in soapy water. She scrubbed and scrubbed until all the yucky stuff was gone. When the dress was clean, she put it on. It was not disgusting anymore. Mia revealed her new fashion to her friends. They clapped and said, "Wow, Mia! You look so nice!" And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a pale little girl named Amy. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, her mom was baking a cake in the oven. The oven was big and warm. Amy was very excited to eat the cake.

Amy wanted to help her mom with the cake. So, she asked, "Mom, can I help you with the cake?" Her mom said, "Yes, Amy, you can help me mix the cake batter." Amy was very happy to help her mom.

They mixed the cake batter together and put it in the oven. Amy and her mom waited for the cake to bake. When the cake was ready, they took it out of the oven. The cake smelled so good! Amy and her mom ate the cake together, and it was the best cake they ever had.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to play outside. He saw a big box near the tree. Tim was very curious. He wanted to know what was inside. So, he went closer to the box and took a peek.

Inside the box, Tim found a toy gun. He was so happy! He picked up the gun and started to play with it. He pretended to be a superhero, saving the world from bad guys. Tim ran around the yard, laughing and having fun.

After playing for a while, Tim started to feel hungry. He went back to his house and saw his mom in the kitchen. She had made some yummy cookies for him. Tim ate the cookies and told his mom about the toy gun and his adventures. His mom smiled and gave him a big hug.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play with animals. One day, they go to the zoo with Mom and Dad. They see many animals, like lions, monkeys, and elephants. They are very happy.

They come to a big cage with birds. The birds have many colors, like red, blue, and yellow. Lily and Ben want to see them closer. They rush to the cage and put their faces on the bars. They say hello to the birds.

But one bird is not happy. It is pale and sad. It does not sing or fly. It sits on a branch and looks at Lily and Ben. Lily and Ben see the bird and feel sorry for it. They ask Mom and Dad why the bird is pale and sad.

Mom and Dad say the bird is sick. It needs a doctor and medicine. They say the zoo people are trying to help the bird. They say Lily and Ben can pray for the bird to get better.

Lily and Ben nod. They say bye to the bird and tell it to be strong. They hope the bird will get better soon. They go to see other animals, but they do not forget the pale and sad bird. They pray for it in their hearts.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Furry. Furry loved to eat beans, but one day he ate too many and got a tummy ache. He decided to take a nap to feel better.

While Furry was sleeping, a big monster came and tried to take his favorite toy. Furry woke up and saw the monster. He was scared, but he knew he had to be brave. Furry stood up and said, "I surrender my toy to you."

The monster was surprised by Furry's bravery and kindness. He gave Furry back his toy and they became friends. From that day on, Furry learned to share his toys and not eat too many beans. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an angel who liked to run. Everyday the angel flew to different places and ran around having fun. Then one day, an ignorant man saw the angel running and thought it was strange. He shouted, "What are you doing?" So the angel stopped running and was embarrassed.

The angel was too shy to tell the man what it was doing, so instead it flew away. But the man was curious, so he followed the angel. Everywhere the angel went, the man followed. The angel was scared and kept running and running until it was too tired to fly.

The man finally caught up and the angel flew away. But before the angel left, it left a special gift for the man. It was a surprise he had never seen before. When the man opened the gift, he discovered it was a magical toy that could fly and run.

After that day, the man never forgot his experience with the angel. He would play with the toy and remember the kind angel who gave it to him. He was forever thankful for the gift, and the lesson it taught him: Never be ignorant to what is around you.

Once there was a pig named Fred. He was very hungry and looked for something to eat. He saw a big red barn and wanted to go inside to find something to eat. But when he got to the door, he found it was locked. He asked the farmer for food. But the farmer refused. He said that he was not allowed to give food to animals from the barn.

So Fred decided to look for food somewhere else. He went to the farmer's garden and found some delicious fruits and vegetables. He was so excited that he made a big feast! He was so happy that he did not even care that the farmer had refused him.

But suddenly, he heard a noise. It was the farmer, and he was not happy. "What are you doing in my garden? You must get out!" the farmer shouted. But Fred refused. He said he was still very hungry. The farmer was surprised and finally agreed to let Fred stay and eat.

Fred was very happy. Now he could eat until he was full. He thanked the farmer and went back to his barn, his tummy full and happy.

Sam and Lily were playing with their toys in the living room. Sam had a lot of cars and trucks, and Lily had a lot of dolls and animals. They liked to share their toys and make up stories.

One day, Sam had an urge to build a big tower with his blocks. He asked Lily to help him. "Lily, do you want to build a tower with me?" he said.

Lily nodded. "Yes, Sam, that sounds fun. How high do you want to make it?"

Sam thought for a moment. "Very high, like the sky. We need a lot of blocks. Can we use some of your blocks too?"

Lily agreed. "Sure, Sam, we can use some of my blocks. But we have to be organized. We have to sort the blocks by color and size. That way, we can find the ones we need."

Sam and Lily started to sort the blocks. They made piles of red, blue, yellow, and green blocks. They also made piles of big, medium, and small blocks. They worked together and talked to each other.

"Look, Lily, I have a big red block. This can be the base of the tower," Sam said.

"Good idea, Sam. I have a medium blue block. This can go on top of the red block," Lily said.

They continued to supply each other with blocks and stack them on the tower. They made the tower higher and higher, until it reached the ceiling. They were very proud of their tower.

"Wow, Sam, we did it! We made the highest tower ever!" Lily exclaimed.

"Yes, Lily, we did it! We are the best builders!" Sam cheered.

They hugged each other and smiled. They had fun building the tower, and they were happy to share their toys and their urge.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little boy called Joey. His favorite thing to do was to go to the store and buy a yummy pie. All the people who worked at the store loved him because he was so charming.

One day, Joey and his mom went to the store, and Joey asked her to buy him a pie. His mom said, "Of course I will buy you a pie, Joey. You are cute and adorable!".

Joey was very excited, and couldn't wait to get the pie. The shop assistant gave him the pie and asked, "Do you have to pay now or later?". Joey said, "I have to pay later. I don't have any money with me. I'm only three years old!".

The shop assistant thought Joey was so cute and said, "Don't worry, you can pay next time you come." Joey thanked the shop assistant and then ran off with the pie. He was so excited to eat his delicious treat!

Once there was a boy named Rob who wanted to buy something incredible. He decided to go to the store and see what he could find.

When Rob got to the store, he saw something even better than incredible - two identical puppies! They were twins, and the boy thought they were the most perfect puppies ever.

Rob asked the storekeeper if he could buy the twins. The storekeeper said "yes" and asked how much money he had. Rob pulled out his piggybank and emptied it on the counter. He had enough money to buy both puppies!

Rob was so happy to take his twins home. He loved them so much that he named them Incredible and Perfect.

From then on, Rob and his incredible twins had lots of fun adventures together. They even became best friends!

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweetie. Tweetie was very graceful when she flew in the sky. She loved to sing and play with her bird friends.

One day, Tweetie's bird friend, Chirpy, came to her and said, "Hey Tweetie, let's go play a quiz game!" Tweetie was excited and said, "Yes, let's go!"

Chirpy had a tricky quiz for Tweetie. She asked, "What is the thing that you use to poke things?" Tweetie thought for a moment and said, "Is it a stick?" Chirpy said, "No, it's something smaller." Tweetie thought again and said, "Is it a finger?" Chirpy said, "Yes, that's right!"

Later that day, Tweetie was flying in the sky when she saw a big, juicy worm on the ground. She remembered the quiz and used her beak to poke the worm. She was so happy that she got the quiz right and found a yummy snack!

Once upon a time, there was a mum and a dad who had a cute little boy. Every day the family would go for a walk in the park.

The sun was bright and the sky was blue. The little boy was full of energy and wanted to play all the time. The mum and dad reminded him to behave and show respect to other people in the park.

Every day the family stayed in the park for a long time. The little boy ran and laughed and made lots of new friends. His mum and dad watched proudly, and the little boy felt very happy.

The family visited the park on a regular basis and the little boy was always so excited to see the sun shine and play with his new friends. Whenever he got too excited, all he needed was a little reminder to behave and he would quickly settle down.

The little family continued to visit the park every week, and the little boy became more and more responsible. He had lots of fun and everyone was happy.

The End.

Today was very exciting. Mommy had a surprise for me. She said we were going to see a parade. I love parades!

Mommy said this parade was special because everyone was wearing super fancy clothes. Mommy said the clothes were so special and expensive. I couldn't believe it!

When we got to the parade I was amazed. I could see people wearing sparkly dresses and fancy hats. The colors were so colorful. I loved it! Even the music was exciting.

I had so much fun. I felt so happy and couldn't stop smiling. I just knew it was going to be the best day ever.

I'm excited for the next parade. I just know it will be even more exciting!

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Timmy. Timmy loved going on picnics with his family. One day, they went on a picnic and Timmy's mom brought a cooler. Timmy wanted to help and tried to carry the cooler, but it was too heavy for him.

During the picnic, Timmy's mom asked him to fold the picnic blanket. Timmy didn't want to do it because he thought it was too hard. But then he remembered how he couldn't carry the cooler and realized that he needed to try his best. He folded the blanket and felt proud of himself.

When they got home, Timmy's mom told him that it's important to try your best and help out, even if things seem hard. Timmy felt happy that he could help and promised to always try his best. From that day on, Timmy always helped out on picnics and felt proud of himself for being a good helper.

Once there was a little girl called Kate. Kate was always adding new things to her toy box. One day, she saw a really cool circle. It was made of a flexible plastic and it looked great!

Kate wanted to add the circle to her toy box right away. She took it out and rolled it around, and it moved so quickly! She laughed and smiled as the circle whizzed around the room. Kate was so happy with her new circle.

After a while, Kate decided to add the circle to her toy box. She put it carefully in the middle of all her other toys, and then locked the box. Now the circle was safe and Kate could enjoy playing with it whenever she had time.

Kate loved having the circle in her toy box. She imagined all the fun things she would do with the flexible circle. She was very happy it was part of her collection.

One sunny day, a pirate was wandering through the woods. He had a big, shining hat, two swords and a wooden leg. Suddenly he heard a noise coming from the bushes. The pirate stopped and listened carefully.

"Ouch, it hurts", a small voice called out from the bushes.

The pirate went to investigate, and he saw a little girl, who was crying. The pirate asked her why she was crying, but she only shook her head.

The pirate lifted the little girl out of the bushes, and asked her again why she was so hurt. This time she told the pirate that she had been playing hide-and-seek with her friend, and had gotten lost.

The pirate put his arm around the little girl, and smiled down at her. He promised he would lead her home, so she wouldn't be hurt anymore. As the two walked, the pirate told her stories about his adventures of sailing the seven seas.

The pirate took the little girl home, and stayed to make sure she was safe. Both the little girl and the pirate were happy about this. The little girl had learned an important lesson - always listen to your parents, so you don't get lost. And the pirate had learned a lesson too - helping out others can make you feel good.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. One day Lucy wanted to go for an adventure, so she took her luggage and hopped on a bus.

When she arrived at the destination, she was excited to explore. As she wandered around, Lucy tried to guess what she would find.

Just then, she heard a voice speaking. She looked around and saw a friendly man.

Lucy asked the man, "What is this place?"

The man smiled and said, "This is a successful market. People come here to sell and buy things."

Lucy was amazed. She said goodbye to the man and continued exploring the market. She guessed that she would have a successful adventure. And she was right!

Once upon a time there was a jolly old man. He loved to surprise his friends.

One day he decided to surprise his best friend. He hopped on his bike and went for a ride. He rode for a long time until he arrived at his friend's house.

When he knocked on the door, his friend was so busy he didn't hear. The old man knocked and knocked until finally the friend came to answer. His friend was very surprised to see him there.

"Oh my! What a surprise! What made you come here?" the friend asked.

The old man laughed. "I wanted to bring you something," he said.

The old man's friend grew very worried. He was afraid the old man had come with bad news. But the old man surprised him once again when he pulled out a big, delicious cake from his basket.

The friend was so happy and relieved. He thanked the old man and quickly invited him inside for tea and cake.

The old man smiled happily. He had brought a jolly surprise and it had made his friend worry in the best way.

Once there was a little girl called Sally. She was three years old and loved to learn. That's why her parents hired a tutor to help her learn lots of new things. Every day, the tutor came to teach Sally something new.

One day, Sally managed to learn something new all by herself. She was very proud when the tutor said it was right. So, her parents decided to celebrate Sally's accomplishment. They bought her a new toy and invited all her friends over to join the celebration.

The day of the celebration came and everyone was excited. But when Sally saw the tutor, she began to cry. Sally didn't want to celebrate because she was scared that the tutor would be angry if she made a mistake.

Sally's parents comforted her and explained that it was ok to make mistakes. Everyone wants to learn and the tutor was there to help her get better. They reassured her that the tutor was proud of her and that it was ok to celebrate.

Finally, Sally understood that the tutor was happy for her and wanted to celebrate too. With the tutor's help, Sally celebrated her success with her friends and family. The celebration was lots of fun and Sally felt proud of herself.

Tim and Sue were friends. They liked to play with toys and eat snacks. One day, they found a big bag of prunes in the kitchen. They thought prunes were yummy and sweet.

"Let's eat some prunes!" Tim said.

"OK!" Sue said.

They opened the bag and took out some prunes. They put them in their mouths and chewed. But the prunes were not yummy and sweet. They were dry and sour and bitter. They made their faces twist and their tongues hurt.

"Yuck!" Tim said. "These prunes are stupid!"

"Yuck!" Sue said. "They are bad!"

They spat out the prunes and threw them on the floor. They were angry and sad. They wanted something good to eat.

They looked around the kitchen and saw a big cake on the table. It was white and pink and had candles on it. It looked yummy and sweet.

"Let's eat some cake!" Tim said.

"OK!" Sue said.

They ran to the table and grabbed some cake. They put it in their mouths and smiled. It was yummy and sweet. It made their faces happy and their tongues glad.

"Mmm!" Tim said. "This cake is good!"

"Mmm!" Sue said. "It is nice!"

They ate more and more cake. They did not care about the prunes. They did not see the note on the table. It said: "Happy Birthday, Mom! Do not touch the cake!"

They ate all the cake. They felt full and sick. They clapped their hands and laughed. They thought they were clever and funny.

But they were not clever and funny. They were naughty and rude. They did not know that Mom was coming home soon. They did not know that Mom loved cake and wanted to share it with them. They did not know that Mom would be very angry and sad when she saw what they did.

They did not know that they were in big trouble.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl and her name was Jana. She was three years old, and she lived with her mom and dad. One day Jana wanted to watch her favourite show on the TV. She asked her mom if she could watch it, but her mom told her she had to wait.

So Jana's mom went to Jana, gave her a hug and urged her to find something else to do. Jana said to her mom, "OK, I'll do something else, but can I still watch my show after?" Her mom replied, "Yes, you can watch it a

Once upon a time there was a girl called Jean. She was three years old.
One day while she was playing in the garden Jean found a basket. It was filled with special things - one of them was a special toy. Jean was so happy!

But Jean's brother was very jealous. He wanted Jean's toy all for himself. So his took the toy and ran away!

Jean was so sad. She wanted her toy back, but she didn't know where her brother had gone. Suddenly she had an idea. She decided to bury the basket near the tree in the garden and hope that her brother would find it.

Jean dug a deep, deep hole and put the basket in it. Then she covered it up with lots and lots of dirt and stones. Then she went inside to wait.

But Jean's brother was very, very stupid! He never even looked for the basket. So Jean's special toy stayed buried forever!

One day, a nice girl named Lucy went to visit her friend Tom. Tom was very happy to see Lucy. They liked to play together. They played with their toy cars and dolls. They had a lot of fun.

As they played, Lucy hurt her finger. "Ouch!" she said, "My finger hurts!" Tom looked at her finger and saw a little red spot. He wanted to help Lucy feel better.

Tom went to his mom and asked for a band-aid. He put the band-aid on Lucy's finger. "Thank you, Tom," said Lucy with a smile. "You're a good friend." Now, Lucy's finger felt better, and they continued to play and have a nice day together.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Jane. She loved to wear a special shirt every day; it was an important shirt. Today, it was even more special. Jane put on her shirt which shone in the sunlight. She was so happy wearing it!

"Good morning Jane!" said her Mom. "I see you are wearing your special shirt today. Love how it shines!"

Jane smiled.

"We're going to the park!" said Mom.

When they got to the park, Jane saw a crowd of people, who were smiling and wearing shiny shirts. She was so intrigued.

"What's going on?" Jane asked.

"It's a special day, Jane," Mom said. "Today is your birthday, and you are surrounded by your friends. We wanted to celebrate by all wearing our special shirts."

At that moment, Jane realized how important her shirt was and smiled.

Once there was a little girl called Mia. She was very excited to explore outside. She found a special mine and ran inside. The mine was filled with amazing objects and materials. Mia couldnâ€™t believe her eyes.

Once upon a time there was a beautiful pool. It was so big and so deep and so blue. One day, a little boy named Jack was playing by the pool. He wanted to jump in, so he took hold of the edge and jumped in with a big splash.

But when Jack got out of the water, he was crying. He had tears streaming down his face. He had torn his shirt when he jumped in the pool. He was so sad.

But Jack's mom came and gave him a hug. She wiped away his tears and told him not to worry. She said she would take him to the store and get him a new shirt.

Jack smiled and his tears were gone. He was so happy to be able to go back in the beautiful pool. He went back in, jumped and splashed around with a big smile on his face.

The End.

Tim and Lily were best friends. They liked to play together every day. They had a loyal dog named Spot, who followed them everywhere. Spot was very smart and could do many tricks.

One day, Tim and Lily decided to play hide and seek in the park. Tim was the seeker and Lily was the hider. Lily ran to find a good hiding place. She saw a big toilet near the playground. She thought it was a funny place to hide. She went inside and closed the door.

Tim counted to ten and then started to look for Lily. He looked behind the trees, under the benches, and in the swings. He could not find her. He asked Spot to help him. Spot sniffed the air and wagged his tail. He ran to the toilet and barked.

Tim followed Spot and saw the toilet. He knocked on the door and said, "Lily, are you in there? I found you!"

Lily opened the door and smiled. She said, "You are very good at finding me, Tim. And Spot is very helpful. He is a loyal friend."

Tim and Lily hugged and laughed. They thanked Spot and gave him a treat. They decided to play another game. They had a lot of fun in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a human who loved to dance. He would move his body in smooth movements and made everyone smile. Even when he was alone, he always seemed to be dancing.

One day, he saw a beautiful meadow filled with flowers and he knew it was the perfect place to dance. He smiled and started moving his body, spinning and twirling through the meadow. He felt so free and happy.

He moved so smoothly that some of the animals in the meadow stopped and watched. A rabbit, a squirrel, and a deer were all mesmerized by the human's dance. The human laughed and waved at them as he continued.

Soon the sun started to set and the human knew it was time to go home. He thanked the animals for watching, and he gave them each a hug before he left. He took a deep breath and smiled, knowing he had enjoyed a wonderful day of smooth dancing.

Sarah was packing her house. She had to move to a new place, but she was very excited. She gathered up all her things and made them easy to carry. She put her books, pencils, clothes, and dolls into bags. She packed up her bed and the chairs too. Finally, everything was ready to go. She grabbed the bags and said goodbye to her house. She was excited to see her new home!

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lily. She loved flowers and would often go outside to pick them. One day, she found a beautiful flower and decided to sing to it. The flower looked happy and danced in the breeze as Lily sang.

Lily was a patient girl and waited for the flower to grow bigger and stronger. Every day, she would water it and sing to it. One day, the flower bloomed into a big, colorful flower. Lily was so happy and continued to sing to it every day.

From then on, Lily would sing to all the flowers in her garden. She loved how they would dance and sway to her singing. And the flowers loved Lily too, because she was so patient and kind to them. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim and his baby brother, Sam. They lived in a house with a high tree in the yard. Tim loved to climb the high tree and look at the sky.

One day, Tim said, "Sam, I want to protect you. Let's play under the high tree." Sam smiled and followed his brother. They played together, laughing and having fun.

Suddenly, a big bird flew down from the high tree. Tim stood in front of Sam and said, "I will protect you, brother!" The big bird saw how brave Tim was and flew away. Sam hugged Tim and said, "Thank you for protecting me, brother." They went back to playing, safe and happy under the high tree.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to visit her grandma. When she got there, her grandma gave her a big hug and said, "Hello, Lily! You are so polite."

Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, grandma!" Then, her grandma showed her how to do the lock on the front door. "You have to turn the key like this," she said, as she demonstrated.

Lily watched carefully and then tried it herself. She did it perfectly! "I did it, grandma!" she exclaimed. Her grandma smiled and said, "You are such a smart girl, Lily." And they spent the rest of the day playing together.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very creative. She had a chair in her room and everyday she would keep it in the same spot.
One day, the little girl wanted to be creative with her chair. She decided to keep it outside in the garden. She wanted to sit on it and enjoy the sun.

So she put the chair in the garden. It was a perfect spot. She kept her chair there all day. The sun was shining and she was happy. She sang and danced in the chair.

When the sun went down, the little girl kept her chair in the same spot in the garden and went back inside her house. She was so happy with her creative idea!

The end!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, they decided to play a game with a flag. They would take turns holding the flag and running around the yard.

Timmy was very excited when it was his turn to hold the flag. He ran as fast as he could, but then he tripped and fell. The flag flew out of his hand and snapped in the wind.

Timmy's friends were worried, but Timmy was calm. He knew it was just an accident and that they could fix the flag. They all worked together to tape the flag back together, and soon they were back to playing their game. Timmy was happy that his friends were there to help him when he needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a little seed. The seed was planted in the land. The sun shone and the rain fell, and the little seed began to grow. It grew and grew until it became a big, strong tree.

The tree was very obedient. It stood tall and straight, never leaning or swaying in the wind. The animals in the land loved to play around the tree, and the tree gave them shade from the hot sun.

As the tree grew, it gave fruits and nuts for the animals to eat. The animals were happy and grateful for the tree's kindness. And so, the tree continued to grow, and it became a beloved part of the land.

A boy named John was at the park one day, feeling strong and excited. He heard a sound nearby. He looked around, and he saw big trees with lots of green leaves. He also saw a big chainsaw in the hands of a man wearing a hat.

John got curious and he asked, "What are you doing?"

The man smiled and he said, "I am cutting down this tree."

John watched as the man used the chainsaw to cut the branches. After a while, the tree was cut down and the man smiled. He said, "This tree is big and strong, yet I have cut it down."

John was amazed at how the man could cut down a big and strong tree. He said, "Wow!"

Once upon a time there was a big, round thing called Earth. It was very interesting and included lots of things.

The Earth had green grass, bright blue sky, fluffy clouds, and naughty bugs. There were big birds that flew high in the sky and funny fish that swam in the oceans.

The Earth had people who lived on it too. Some people had beds to sleep in, and some people had sweaters to keep them warm. Some people ate ice cream, and some people ate pizza.

The Earth was a very special place with lots of things for people to see and do. From time to time people visited the Earth from other places and joined in the fun.

The Earth was full of interesting things and everyone liked it very much.

Once upon a time, there was a small pepper. It was growing in a garden near a big tree. The pepper was happy, but it wasn't sure why. One day, it decided to ask the tree why it was happy.

It asked, "Why am I so happy?". The big tree was quiet for a moment and then it said, "You are happy because you are alive".

The small pepper was surprised. It started thinking about the words the tree had said. It thought about how amazing it was to be alive and when it looked around, it realised that the garden was full of other small peppers.

The pepper was so happy that it thanked the tree and went off to show its friends. Now, every time the pepper looks out into the garden, it remembers what the tree said and it smiles.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the grass and flowers. One day, she saw a spider crawling on her arm. She was scared and wanted to squish it, but her mom told her that spiders are special and they help catch bugs.

Lily thought about it and realized that even though spiders might look scary, they are unique and important. She decided to let the spider crawl away and not hurt it.

Later that day, Lily was playing with her toys and saw her little brother playing with one of her favorite toys. She felt angry and wanted to take it back, but then she remembered what her mom said about spiders. She realized that just like spiders are special, her brother is special too and he needs to play with toys too.

From that day on, Lily learned that everyone is unique and has their own needs. She didn't want to be mean to anyone and always tried to share her toys with her brother and friends.

Mama was very happy. She was going to a party. She wanted to decorate the house. She got her brush and some paint and started to paint the walls. She was so excited.

When Papa saw the walls, he was very angry. He said it was not a good idea. Mama was sad. She started to cry.

But then, everyone at the party said the house was beautiful. They praised Mama for her decorations. She was so happy. Everyone clapped and celebrated.

Mama hugged Papa and thanked him for helping her. The party was a great success!

The cave was so dark and deep. Claire was very brave and went inside. Inside, she found a loyal wolf. She pet the wolf and it smiled at her.

Claire began to get very dirty, so she and the wolf went to the creek to bathe. They both splashed around and laughed. The wolf was so happy to be around such a brave girl.

With all the splashing, Claire got very clean. She hugged the wolf and thanked him for being so loyal.

Then, Claire and the wolf walked out of the cave, the sun's light was so bright and warm. Claire and the wolf knew that their friendship was very strong.

One day, Tom and his mom went to the pool. It was a hot day, and Tom wanted to go swimming. Tom's mom put her red towel on a chair and told Tom to hang his green towel on the hook. Tom hung his towel up and ran to the pool. The water was cool and it felt nice to Tom.

He swam around the pool with his float. He didn't want to get out. But soon, Tom got weak. He couldn't swim anymore and he started to feel tired.

His mom called out to him, "Tom, it's time to go. I can see you are getting weak. Come out of the pool and hang up your towel."

Tom got out of the pool and hung his towel back up. He was glad he was able to hang his towel back up by himself. Tom picked up his mom's towel, and together, they walked home.

Once upon a time there was a big, roaring lion. He was brave and fierce, and he lived far away in a distant forest.
One day the lion was feeling a bit sick, so he went to the doctor. The doctor gave him some magic powder and told him it would make him better.

The lion was so excited to try it, he drank the whole thing down in one gulp! And what do you know, it worked!

The lion felt much better, and he roared so loud that it shook the tall trees and scared away all the birds. He was feeling so strong and healthy that he decided to thank the doctor.

So off went the lion, bounding through the trees and soaring through the air as he made his way back to the doctor's hut. When he got there, the doctor was so happy to see him looking so well.

The lion thanked the doctor for the magic powder and then, with a hearty "roar", he bounded off into the distant forest, free and strong, ready to enjoy the rest of his day.

One day, two children were walking in the park. One of the children called out, "Look! There is so much ice over there!"
The other child said, "Let's cover it and make it a big slide!"
The first child said, "That's a great idea!"
The two children ran to the ice and started to try and cover it. They pushed and tugged, but it was too heavy. As they kept trying, the ice started to crack.
Suddenly, there was a loud noise and the ice broke apart, and the children tumbled down. As they looked around, they saw that the ice had all broken up and gone away. The heavy ice was now gone.
The two children looked at each other in shock and sadness. They had hoped to make a nice slide but in the end, their plan had gone wrong.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a toy rabbit that she loved very much. One day, Lily's mom suggested that they go to a beautiful park. Lily was excited and said, "Yes, please!"

At the park, they saw lots of trees, flowers, and a big pond with ducks. Lily's mom suggested they have a picnic by the pond. They ate sandwiches and fruit, and Lily's mom suggested they play a game of catch.

After playing, they went to a lab where Lily's mom worked. It was a big room with lots of machines and tools. Lily thought it was very interesting, but also a bit scary. Her mom showed her some pretty crystals that were very beautiful. Lily was happy to have seen something new and exciting.

Once upon a time there was a bubble floating in the sky. It was a delicate bubble, so light that it seemed like it would float away any moment. Two children saw it from the ground below and wanted to look at it more closely. The two kids ran and jumped, stretching their arms up high try to touch the bubble. But the bubble kept floating away, too far away to reach.

The two children looked around them, trying to think of a way to get to the bubble. Then they saw a big tree with lots of sturdy branches near them. It was tall enough to reach the bubble in the sky, so the two kids started to climb.

The children climbed up, higher and higher until they could just reach the bubble. Carefully they grabbed the bubble, being careful not to burst it. The bubble felt so delicate in their hands!

Once the children had the bubble safely in their hands, they made some wishes. Suddenly the bubble started to shine so brightly that it lit up the sky. When the light faded, the bubble popped. All that was left were tiny bits of sparkling dust drifting in the air.

Pam was walking through the forest when she saw something black. It was a huge black bear! Pam stopped and looked around nervously, but the bear did not move. Pam inched closer, wondering why it wasn't moving. Suddenly, it spoke to her.

"Do not be afraid," the bear said. "I will not yield."

Pam was very surprised that the bear spoke. She cautiously asked, "What do you mean?"

The bear replied, "I will return to this forest once a year, so that I can watch it grow and thrive."

Pam smiled, realizing how brave this bear was. With a nod, she said goodbye and continued her walk through the forest. She was glad she had met the brave black bear.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, while playing in the park, she heard a loud noise. It was a dog barking! Lily was scared and wanted to go home.

But then, her friend Emma told her that the dog was harmless and wouldn't hurt them. Lily felt better and continued to play.

Later that day, Lily's mom told her that she won a prize for being kind to her little brother. Lily was so happy and proud of herself. She couldn't wait to see what the prize was!

Once upon a time, there was a furry cat named Kitty. Kitty lived in a small house with a little girl named Sue. Sue loved Kitty very much and played with her every day.

One day, Sue made a sandwich for lunch. She put it on a plate and sat down to eat. Kitty came over and sniffed the sandwich. She liked the smell and wanted some too. Kitty looked at Sue and said, "Meow, meow!" Sue knew that Kitty was asking for some of her sandwich.

Sue said, "Kitty, you can't have my sandwich. It's not for cats." But Kitty did not give up. She meowed louder and louder, demanding some of the sandwich. Sue finally gave in and shared a small piece with Kitty. They both enjoyed their lunch together and were happy.

Peggy was feeling bored so she decided to go outside to explore. As soon as she stepped outside, she saw something disgusting. It was a big tuna flopping around in the mud. It was so gross!

Peggy screamed, "Ewwww!" She wanted to get away from the slimy fish.

Suddenly, a friendly voice said, "Don't be frightened little one. That tuna won't hurt you."

Peggy looked around and saw a kind looking old lady standing nearby. She asked, "Why is the tuna so yucky?"

The old lady smiled and said, "It got stuck in the mud pit. That's why it looks so disgusting. It needs help getting out. Would you like to help?"
