Once upon a time there was a little girl. Her name was Millie. She was 3-years-old and very curious. One day, Millie sneaked away and went to explore a nearby bush. Millie forgot about the time and soon her mom called her back home. Millie was embarrassed because she had been gone so long.

When Millie got home, her mom decided to cook them a special dinner. She made Millie a yummy bowl of spaghetti and meatballs. Millie ate every bite and was so happy.

Millie never ever snuck away to explore another bush again. She was just too embarrassed.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a regular girl called Alice. One day, she went out to explore the wild woods and found a big, red ball. Excited, she picked it up and kicked it away. Suddenly, a strange voice said, "Hey! Don't kick my ball!" Startled, Alice looked around, but there was nobody there. Strangely, Alice heard the same voice again, "Hey Alice, can you give me my ball back? Please?"

Alice couldn't believe it. But, she was brave and ran to get the ball. This time, she saw a little creature standing there. It was a furry, little fox! But, it had wings!

Alice asked, "Are you the one who asked for the ball?". The fox nodded and smiled.

Alice gave the fox the ball and the fox thanked her. Together, they kicked the ball, up and down and around, until the sun went away.

Alice said goodbye to the fox and promised to come back soon. She left the wild woods happy, with a big smile on her face.

Once upon a time there was a brave man who wanted to save the world. He looked high and low until finally he found the perfect place. It was a magical spot that held a secret.

The brave man soon found out that the secret was one of foolishness, and so he decided to take action. He worked hard, both day and night, to save the place. He collected the foolish things and threw them away.

Finally the place was saved. Everyone in the world was so happy and thankful. They all celebrated the brave man's hard work and praised him for saving their special place.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Every day, he went outside to play games with all of his friends.

Tim was always excited to play and always wanted to win, so he tried his best every time. One day, he was playing on the jungle gym, and all his friends were jealous of how good he was.

A lawyer walked by and said to them, "Why don't you all give Tim a challenge and make him prove that he is the best?"

All of the children agreed, so they made a contest. Whoever could stay on the jungle gym the longest would be crowned the winner. Tim was very happy and took on the challenge.

He made it to the end, but his friends said he cheated. The lawyer stepped in and said, "you must all prove that he was guilty of cheating before you can declare him the winner".

The friends started arguing, but the lawyer said there was no need. He had seen Tim play the entire time and said he was the clear winner.

Everyone was happy and celebrated Tim's victory. From that day on, he was nicknamed the 'King of the Jungle Gym' and everyone know not to mess with him.

Once upon a time there was a purple mop. The mop lived in a big, pink room. Every morning the mop would wake up ready for the day!

The mop would enjoy the bright sunshine that shone through the window and the birds chirping outside. Then, the mop would be ready to start its day.

Every morning it would go over to the floor and start to clean. It felt so nice having the floor all clean. After the mop had finished it would sit back,dance around and sing.

The purple mop was so happy and enjoyed its days, it wanted to help out around the house all the time. All the people in the house were so pleased they had the purple mop keeping their floors squeaky clean.

The days became so much fun for everyone and the purple mop loved being useful. It was a job it was perfect for! So, the purple mop kept waking up every morning to keep the house clean and everyone happy.

Once there was a little girl named Lucy. She went walking with her mom one day and they found an orange glove on the ground.

"Mommy," Lucy said, "can I keep the glove?"

"I suppose so," replied her mom.

Lucy was so happy and hugged the glove tightly. When she got home, she put it on her hand and started walking around. Suddenly she heard a sound.

"What is that noise?" Lucy asked.

"It's the fire station's bell," her mom said. "It's ringing to tell the firefighters that someone needs help."

Lucy looked at her orange glove and smiled. She knew that if she was ever in danger she could ring the glove, and the firefighters would come to help her.

Once there was a young girl named Maria. She was only three years old and full of energy!

One day, Maria was playing in the garden next to her house when something special happened. She saw a colourful truck driving quickly down the road. Maria ran to the truck and saw that it was filled with fuel.

The truck driver called out to Maria, asking her if she would like some of the tasty fuel. Maria was excited and said yes. The driver gave her a big can of the fuel.

Maria took the can and thanked the driver. She ran back to her garden full of excitement and opened her can. Maria was very pleased with the taste of the fuel! She shared it with her close friends and they all had a great time.

Tom and Anna were twins who liked to play in the living room. They saw a big tree with shiny things on it. Mommy said the shiny things were ornaments and they were very pretty. She also said they were very fragile and they should not touch them.

But Tom and Anna were curious and wanted to see the ornaments up close. They waited until Mommy was busy in the kitchen and then they tiptoed to the tree. They reached for the ornaments and tried to take them off the branches. But the ornaments were slippery and some of them fell to the floor. They made a loud noise and broke into pieces.

Mommy heard the noise and came to the living room. She saw the broken ornaments and the mess on the floor. She was very angry and sad. She said to Tom and Anna, "What have you done? You have destroyed the ornaments! They were very special to me. They were from Grandma and Grandpa. They are gone now and I can't fix them. You are very naughty and you have to go to your room. No more playing for you today."

Tom and Anna felt very sorry and scared. They did not mean to destroy the ornaments. They just wanted to look at them. They said to Mommy, "We are sorry, Mommy. We did not know they were from Grandma and Grandpa. We did not know they would break. Please don't be mad at us. We love you, Mommy."

Mommy sighed and hugged them. She said, "I love you too, Tom and Anna. But you have to be more careful and listen to me. The ornaments were very important to me and I can't get them back. You have to learn to respect other people's things. Now go to your room and think about what you did. Maybe later we can talk more and make some new ornaments together."

Tom and Anna nodded and went to their room. They felt very bad and wished they had not touched the ornaments. They hoped Mommy would forgive them and they could make her happy again. They sat on their beds and were very quiet.

Once upon a time, there was a kind and compassionate person. He wanted to help everyone he saw. One day, he saw a little bird in the street and it was very hungry. He wanted to help the bird, so he gave it a piece of bread to eat. The bird was so happy and the man was glad he could help the bird.

The next day, the man saw the same bird again in the street and it looked just as hungry. Again, he gave the bird a piece of bread to eat. This time the bird was more than just happy. It was very grateful and thankful for the man's compassion.

Every day for a month, the man and the bird continued to meet in the street and the man would always give the bird a piece of bread to eat. Over time, the bird's stomach filled up. The man was overjoyed. He had been kind and compassionate and now the bird was doing better.

Lily was a little girl who liked to play with her dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite was Anna, who had a pink dress and a charming smile. Lily always took Anna with her when she went out.

One day, Lily and her mom went to visit her grandma, who lived in a big house. Lily was happy to see her grandma, who gave her a hug and a cookie. But she was also curious about the other rooms in the house. She asked her mom if she could explore.

"OK, but be careful and don't go too far," her mom said. "And don't open any doors that are locked."

Lily nodded and ran off with Anna. She saw many doors, some open and some closed. She peeked into some of the open ones and saw a bedroom, a bathroom, a kitchen, and a library. She wondered what was behind the closed ones.

She came to a door that had a sign that said "Do Not Enter". Lily felt a tingle of excitement. She wanted to know what was inside. She tried the knob, but it was locked. She looked around and saw a key on a hook. She reached for it and put it in the lock. She turned it and heard a click. She opened the door and stepped in.

She gasped. The room was dark and dusty. There were many old things, like books, toys, clothes, and pictures. But there was also something else. Something big and furry and scary. It was a bear!

The bear saw Lily and roared. It stood up on its hind legs and showed its teeth and claws. Lily was terrified. She dropped Anna and ran back to the door. But the door was shut and locked. She had left the key inside. She banged on the door and screamed for help.

"Mom! Grandma! Help me! There's a bear in here!"

Her mom and grandma heard her and came running. They saw the sign and the key and realized what had happened. They quickly opened the door and pulled Lily out. The bear growled and tried to follow, but they slammed the door and locked it again.

Lily hugged her mom and grandma and sobbed. She was sorry for being naughty and opening the door. She was also sad for losing Anna. Her mom and grandma comforted her and told her it was OK. They also explained that the bear was not real, but a stuffed animal that belonged to her grandpa, who used to collect them. He had put them in a special room to keep them safe.

Lily felt a little better, but she still missed Anna. She asked her mom and grandma if they could get her back. They said they would try, but they had to wait until the bear calmed down. They took Lily to the living room and gave her some milk and cookies. They also gave her another doll to play with, but Lily knew it was not the same as Anna.

She hoped that Anna was OK and that the bear was not mean to her. She wished she could meet her again and tell her she was sorry and that she loved her. She hoped that Anna still had her charming smile.

One day there was a bald man who worked in a factory. Every morning he would wake up and go to work. One day something strange and wonderful happened - it started to spring!

The man felt so happy he decided to take the day off, so he jumped out of bed, put on his coat and quickly ran outside! The ground was wet and muddy. He laughed as he splashed around and enjoyed the warm air. The sun was shining, the birds were singing and the flowers were blooming all around him.

He noticed a butterfly fluttering around and stopped to watch it. Suddenly the butterfly flew onto his head and rested there. He was amazed and knew that this was a special moment! He kept walking and enjoyed the fresh air and beauty of the world around him.

Soon enough he had to go back to the factory but he knew that he would always remember the special day when he felt the beauty and joy of spring.

Once upon a time, there was a very powerful lion. He had a special suit that allowed him to roar very loudly. He was so loud that the whole jungle could hear him. Everyone was scared of him, because he was so powerful.

The lion decided to take a walk in the forest one day. As he was walking, he roared and roared. All of the animals in the jungle began to flee. Even the brave tigers ran away scared. The lion had never felt so powerful before.

He kept walking and roaring until he had enough. He stopped, took off his suit and went home. Everyone in the jungle felt safe again.

The lion never forgot how powerful he felt that day. He kept his special suit and always remembered how much fun it was to roar.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world around her. One day, she found a big knot in a tree. It was so big, she couldn't untie it no matter how hard she tried.

Lily's friend, a little bird named Tweetie, flew over to see what she was doing. "What's wrong, Lily?" Tweetie asked. "I can't untie this knot," Lily replied. "I don't believe I can do it."

Tweetie hopped onto the knot and began to peck at it with his beak. After a few minutes, the knot came loose! Lily was so happy and dizzy with excitement that she hugged Tweetie tightly. "Thank you, Tweetie! You're the best friend ever," she said. From then on, Lily knew that with a little help from her friends, she could do anything she believed in.

Molly and Timmy wanted to color. But there was no table to put their coloring book on. Timmy was confused. He asked Molly what they should do. She smiled and said, "Let's hope for a table!" So Molly and Timmy both held their hands in the air and hoped for a table.

Suddenly, the door opened. It was Molly's mom. She brought in a big table! She said, "I found this in the attic," with a big smile on her face. Molly and Timmy cheered and thanked Molly's mom.

Then they set their table up in the living room. They opened their coloring books and got to coloring. They sat around the table and made many beautiful pictures. Molly and Timmy smiled. They were so happy they had a table!

Tim and Mia are twins. They like to play with their toys and pretend they are in space. They have a big box that they call their rocket. They put stickers on it and draw stars and planets.

One day, they decide to go on a mission to explore the universe. They put on their helmets and suits and get inside the box. They count down from ten and then make loud noises like a rocket.

"Zoom! Zoom! We are flying to the moon!" Tim says.

"Look! There is a big cheese ball!" Mia says. She points to a yellow ball on the floor.

"Can we eat it?" Tim asks.

Mia nods. They get out of the box and run to the ball. They pick it up and take a bite.

"Mmm, this is yummy!" Mia says.

She chews the cheese and smiles.

"Wait, this is not cheese!" Tim says.

He spits out the cheese and makes a face.

"This is rubber! It is hard and yucky!"

He throws the ball away and rubs his tongue.

Mia laughs. She thinks it is funny.

"Sorry, Tim. I was joking. That is not the moon. That is our dog's toy. He likes to chew it."

She hugs Tim and says sorry.

Tim is not mad. He hugs Mia back and says it is okay.

They go back to their box and pretend they are in space again.

They have fun and forget about the rubber ball.

They are happy twins. They love to play and explore the universe.

Once upon a time, in a big, green park, there was a small, messy dog named Binky. Binky had a long, waggy tail and loved to play with his friends. One sunny day, Binky and his friends were playing catch with a big, red ball.

As they played, Binky's tail got caught in a bush. "Ouch!" he cried. Binky's friends heard him cry and came running to help. "What's wrong, Binky?" asked his friend, a cute, fluffy bunny named Lulu.

"My tail is stuck!" Binky said with a sad face. Lulu and the other friends tried to help Binky get his tail out of the bush. They pulled and pulled, but it was still stuck.

Then, a wise, old owl named Oliver flew down from a tall tree. "Don't cry, Binky," he said. "I can help you get your tail out." Oliver used his sharp beak to carefully cut the bush and free Binky's tail.

Binky was so happy! He wagged his tail and said, "Thank you, Oliver!" All the friends cheered and clapped. Then, they went back to playing with the big, red ball, laughing and having fun together.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends called Bob and Jay. They were always up for a good time and always wanted to have fun.

One day, Bob and Jay decided to make a castle with things they found around the house. They looked for cardboard boxes, blocks, and glue.

"Where can we find the glue?" asked Jay.

"I think we need to ask Mommy," replied Bob.

So, off they went to ask Mommy where they could find the glue.

Mommy was happy to help. She showed them where they could find the dependable glue and they were so happy. With the glue in hand, Bob and Jay managed to make the most beautiful castle.

Everyone was impressed with the castle they made and Bob and Jay were over the moon. They had such a great time playing with their castle and were so proud of themselves.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the market with her mommy. One day, they went to the market and saw that it was closed. Lily was sad because she wanted to buy some fruits and veggies.

But then, her mommy said they could make their own market at home! They got some paper, crayons, and stickers and made signs for their market. They even made a cash register out of a shoebox.

Lily had so much fun pretending to be a market seller and her mommy pretended to be a customer. They opened their market and had a great time buying and selling pretend fruits and veggies. Lily was so happy that they could still have a market even though the real one was closed.

One day, a small girl called Lucy went outside to play in the park. She liked to make friends with the animals, so she looked around. Suddenly, she saw a pigeon come slowly down to the ground. She was excited and ran over.

"Hello, pigeon!" said Lucy.

The pigeon only cooed in reply. Lucy was disappointed, but then she had an idea. She found some breadcrumbs and put them on the ground.

The pigeon came slowly closer and pecked at the crumbs. Lucy was so happy and she laughed. Then, she said "Let's be friends!"

The pigeon cooed again and Lucy knew it was happy, too. From then on, she would come to the park every day to play with her new friend, the pigeon.

Once there was a young girl named Sandy. She liked to go to the park every day and play with her friends. One day, when Sandy was playing in the park, she saw a man who was sleeping on a bench. She decided to be kind and make him a sandwich.

Sandy made a sandwich and was about to give it to the man. But before she could do so, he woke up and began to yell and disturb everyone. He was very angry and started throwing things around.

Sandy was scared and quickly ran away. Even though she had tried to do something nice for the man, he was so mad that he disturbed the peace. Sandy learned a valuable lesson that day: being too nice can sometimes get you into trouble.

Tom and Lily were playing with their toy trucks in the garden. They had a big pile of sand and some boards to make ramps and bridges. They liked to load their trucks with sand and drive them over the boards.

"Look, Lily, I can load more sand than you!" Tom said. He filled his truck with so much sand that it was very heavy. He tried to drive it over a board, but the board broke in half. The truck and the sand fell to the ground.

"Oh no, Tom, you broke the board!" Lily said. She was sad because they had only two boards left. "Why did you load so much sand?"

"Because I wanted to show you how strong I am," Tom said. He was sorry that he broke the board. He knew that Lily liked to play with the boards too.

"But Tom, being strong is not only about loading a lot of sand," Lily said. "Being strong is also about being kind and sharing with others. If you load less sand, we can both play with the boards and have more fun."

Tom thought about what Lily said. He realized that she was right. He said, "I'm sorry, Lily, you are very smart. I will load less sand and share the boards with you. Can we still be friends?"

"Of course, Tom, we are always friends," Lily said. She smiled and gave him a hug. They picked up the broken board and the sand and put them away. Then they took their trucks and the other boards and played together happily. They learned that being strong is not only about how much you can load, but also about how much you can love.

Once upon a time there was a bug who went for a walk. His name was Mark and he was a very small insect. He had a plan to visit his cousin who lived in a nearby sunflower.

As he hopped along, Mark saw a butterfly and decided to follow it. After a short time, he spotted his cousin's sunflower. He was so excited!

But as soon as he got closer, he stopped in his tracks. He noticed the sunflower was tilted and a branch had been broken off. "Oh no!" he exclaimed sadly. Then he heard a voice telling him to come closer.

It was his cousin! Mark was so excited, but then he saw his cousin was lying on the broken branch, too weak to move. Mark felt so sorry for him. His cousin told him he had a fever and he needed medicine, but he couldn't get any because the medicine was far away.

Mark decided to fetch the medicine, so he flew as far and fast as he could until he finally found the medicine. When he returned, he saw his cousin was feeling much better, thanks to the medicine.

Mark hugged his cousin tightly and said, "I'm so glad I was able to help!" His cousin smiled and offered him a sunflower seed to say thank you.

From that day on, Mark knew he would never forget how important it was to help those in needâ€"even

One day, Jane was walking through the woods searching for a place to take a nap. She had been walking for hours and was feeling very tired. All of a sudden, she spotted a tunnel. She thought it was the perfect place to take a nap and cautiously stepped inside. As soon as she sat down she felt a sense of calm and closed her eyes. Everything was peaceful until she heard a loud voice.

"You can't take a nap here!", yelled a voice.

Jane opened her eyes and saw a squirrel standing in front of her. He continued speaking, "This tunnel is my home. You have to leave or else you will be stuck here forever." Jane was feeling frustrated but knew that the squirrel was right. She slowly began to stand up and as she stepped out of the tunnel, she thanked him for reminding her that she needed to find a better place to take her nap.

The next day, Jane returned to the woods feeling determined to find the perfect place to take a nap. After a while, she noticed a small clearing in a nearby park. She happily ran over to the clearing and laid down in the soft grass. She quickly drifted off to sleep and felt content to have finally taken her nap in a nice and safe place.

Once upon a time, there was a twin brother and sister. They both loved to swim in the big river. One day, the twin brother thought of an idea. He decided that he wanted to swim to the other side of the river. So, he jumped in the water and swam across the river.

As he swam, the water tasted bitter. But he kept going. The twin brother was determined to reach the other side of the river.

After a few minutes, he finally made it to the other side of the river. He was so proud of himself for making it across!

He swam back to the edge of the river and waved at his twin sister on the other side. She was so happy to see him that she started to jump up and down. Then the twins played in the river together until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and color with her crayons. One day, Lily wanted to make a special picture for her mommy. She got out her paper and crayons and started to draw.

Lily was very creative and drew a big flower with lots of petals. She wanted to make the flower even more special, so she decided to spread some honey on the petals. She took a spoon and carefully spread the honey on the petals of the flower. The honey made the flower look shiny and sticky.

When Lily's mommy saw the picture, she was so happy and proud of her creative little girl. She could see the honey on the petals and smiled. Lily was so happy that her mommy loved her picture. From that day on, Lily loved to spread honey on all of her pictures to make them extra special.

Jim was a three year old boy with a big backyard. He liked to spend hours playing in the yard. Every morning, Jim would jump out of bed, eager to get to the yard.

Today he decided to do something special. He stood at the entrance of the yard and looked around. It seemed very interesting. He saw some colorful flowers, tall grass and some big trees. He couldn't wait to explore it all.

He ran around and saw so many things. He especially loved the pond and the swings. Jim stood in the middle of the yard admiring it all. It was the most interesting place he had ever seen.

Jim spent many days exploring his backyard. He loved the adventures he discovered and the stories he made up. He often stood in the yard and admired its beauty. Jim's backyard was his favorite place.

Once upon a time, there was a clear candle. The candle was very shiny and sparkly in the sun.

One day, the candle was walking in the woods. Suddenly, the candle saw a big, scary monster. The monster was very creepy and it had big eyes!

The candle was so scared that it didn't know what to do. Then, it remembered that it had a special power! The candle made a big smile and nodded its head.

The monster smiled too. Suddenly, the monster changed into a friendly puppy in front of the candle. The candle was so happy and it hugged the puppy! From then on, the candle and the puppy were the best of friends.

The puppy and the candle played in the woods every day. They were so happy together. Whenever the candle wanted to play, the puppy would nod its head.

The end.

Lila and Ben are playing in the garden. They have a big bucket of water and some cups. They pour water on the flowers, on the grass, and on each other. They laugh and splash and have fun.

"Look, Lila, I can make a big wave!" Ben says. He fills his cup with water and throws it in the air. The water falls down on Lila's head and makes her wet.

"Hey, Ben, that's not nice!" Lila says. She feels the water on her face and hair. She wipes her face with her hand and shakes her head. "Now I'm all wet and cold!"

"I'm sorry, Lila, I was just playing," Ben says. He sees that Lila is not happy. He wants to make her smile again. He thinks of something. "Do you want to see something funny?"

"What is it?" Lila asks. She is curious.

Ben runs to the clothesline, where his mom hung some clothes to dry. He finds a long scarf that belongs to his dad. He wraps it around his neck and face, leaving only his eyes and nose out. He looks like a mummy. He runs back to Lila and says, "Boo!"

Lila sees Ben and his silly scarf. She forgets that she is wet and cold. She starts to giggle. She thinks Ben looks very funny. She says, "Ben, you look like a mummy! A mummy with a long scarf!"

Ben laughs too. He unwraps the scarf and says, "It's not a mummy, it's me! Do you want to try it?"

Lila nods. She takes the scarf from Ben and wraps it around her neck and face. She says, "Boo!"

They both laugh and play with the scarf. They forget about the water and the cold. They are happy and warm.

Jimmy was a small boy. He loved to mix things.

He went to the kitchen and took a bowl with him. His mom had a big kitchen with a small stove.

Jimmy wanted to mix some things to make a cake. So he put some ingredients in the bowl. He added flour and sugar. Then he mixed them all together.

Next, Jimmy put the bowl on the small stove. He turned the stove on and waited. Then something magical happened - his mixture began to bake into a cake. Jimmy was so excited!

When the cake was ready, Jimmy smiled and took it out of the stove. It smelled delicious. Now Jimmy had a yummy cake to eat!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to listen to music. He had a big collection of CDs and would play them all day long. One day, Timmy's mom came into his room and said, "Timmy, it's time to clean up. Your room is very smelly." Timmy didn't want to stop listening to his music, so he said, "Mom, can I please listen to one more song?" His mom said, "Okay, but after that, you need to clean up."

While Timmy was listening to his music, he heard a loud noise outside. He looked out the window and saw that his neighbor's cat was stuck in a tree. Timmy knew he had to save the cat. He ran outside and climbed up the tree to get the cat. When he got the cat down, his neighbor said, "Thank you, Timmy! You saved my cat!" Timmy felt really proud of himself for being a hero. He went back inside and cleaned up his room, still listening to his music.

Once upon a time, there was a big whale. He was very happy swimming in the ocean. One day, he met a little fish. The fish asked, "Do you have any food to supply me?" The whale replied, "I don't have any food, but I can take you to a place where you can find some."

The whale took the little fish to a beautiful orange reef. The fish was so happy to see all the food he could eat. The whale said goodbye and swam away. But as the little fish was eating, a big shark came and ate him up. The whale never saw the little fish again.

The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Jack and Ben. Jack had a cool toy car and Ben was very envious. Jack wanted to show it to Ben, so he invited him over to his house. When they got there, Jack pointed to a big door and said, "Look! This is my garage!" He was so excited that he could hardly wait to show Ben his car.

Jack opened the door, and then he and Ben stepped inside. They both gasped at what they saw. Jack's car was so shiny and fast! He urged Ben to take a seat and try it out. Ben was so happy, he couldn't believe it!

They had so much fun driving around the driveway. After they were finished, they said goodbye and then Ben went on his way. He was so envious of Jack's car, he really wished it was his. But they remained good friends, and every now and then they would visit each other in the garage.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play with her toys. One day, her favorite toy, a little orange car, broke. Lily was very sad and didn't know what to do.

Her mom saw how sad she was and asked her what was wrong. Lily told her that her car was broken and she didn't know how to fix it. Her mom said, "Don't worry, we can repair it together."

Lily was so happy and helped her mom fix the car. After they were done, her mom gave her a medal for being such a good helper. Lily was so proud of herself and her shiny new medal.

She showed it to her dad and said, "Look! Mom and I repair my car and now I have a medal!" Her dad was so impressed and gave her a big hug. Lily was so happy that her car was fixed and that she got a medal for helping.

One day, a little boy was playing in his garden. He was excited to feel the sun on his face and the grass beneath his feet. Suddenly, he noticed a spider crawling towards him. He became scared and started to move away.

The spider started chasing the little boy, who ran back and forth, looking for a place to hide. He was frustrated that the spider kept following him. Just then, the boy's mother appeared. She said, "What is going on here?"

The little boy replied, "Mummy, there's a spider chasing me. I don't like it."

His mother smiled and said, "That's okay. Spiders won't hurt you. Just try and stay calm and relax."

The little boy tried to take a deep breath and slowly, he began to feel less scared. He said, "Okay, I'm not scared anymore." The spider soon stopped chasing him and he was no longer frustrated. He smiled and said, "Thank you, Mummy!"

Lily and Ben are playing in the park. They see a big brown dog. The dog is friendly and wags its tail. Lily and Ben want to pet the dog.

"Hello, dog!" Lily says. She reaches out her arm to touch the dog's fur. The dog licks her hand and makes a happy sound.

"Can I pet him too?" Ben asks. He moves closer to the dog. The dog looks at him and blinks. Ben thinks the dog is cute and funny.

"Sure, you can pet him," Lily says. She smiles at Ben. They both stroke the dog's back and ears. The dog enjoys the attention and rolls over on the grass.

"Who are you, dog?" Ben wonders. He looks at the dog's collar. There is a tag with a name and a phone number. The name is Max.

"His name is Max," Lily reads. She can read some words. She points at the tag. "And this is his phone number. He has a home and a family."

"Maybe he got lost," Ben says. He feels sorry for Max. He hopes his family will find him soon.

"Let's call his family," Lily says. She has an idea. She runs to the bench where their mom is sitting. She asks for her mom's phone. She tells her mom about Max.

"Good idea, Lily," mom says. She is proud of Lily and Ben. She takes the phone and dials the number on the tag. She talks to someone on the phone. She tells them where they are and that they found Max.

Soon, a car arrives at the park. A man and a woman get out of the car. They look happy and relieved. They run to Max and hug him.

"Max, we missed you so much!" the woman says. She kisses Max on the nose. "Thank you for finding him," she says to Lily, Ben and mom.

"You're welcome," Lily, Ben and mom say. They are glad that Max is safe and reunited with his family.

"Can we play with Max again?" Lily asks.

"Of course, you can," the man says. He smiles at Lily and Ben. "Max loves to play with new friends. Maybe we can come to the park again sometime."

"That would be nice," Lily and Ben say. They wave goodbye to Max and his family. They watch them drive away. They are happy that they helped Max. They go back to playing in the park.

Sam wanted to record a show on tv. He asked his dad to turn on the power.

The power went on and he was ready to record. He pressed the record button and the show started.

Sam was excited to watch the show, but it went too fast for him. He didn't want to miss any of it.

Sam's dad saw that the show was going too fast. He told Sam to press the fast button on the tv.

Sam pressed the fast button. The show slowed down and Sam was able to watch and record it.

Sam was happy that he was able to record the show and he was excited to watch it later.

Once there was a little girl named Kim. One day, Kim went for a walk in the woods near her house. She looked around and saw a big, blue pool. She stepped closer to take a look. Suddenly, she heard a voice from the pool. A frog appeared on a rock in the middle of the pool.

Kim: "Hello, frog!"

Frog: "Where did you come from?"

Kim: "I stepped out of my house."

Frog: "You look very lonely. Do you want to play with me?"

Kim smiled. She stepped into the pool and soon they were playing games. Kim and the frog talked and laughed. Kim forgot how lonely she felt.

When it was time to go, Kim waved goodbye to her frog friend. She felt happier and less alone.

Moral of the story: it is important to make friends and enjoy life. Friends make us feel less lonely.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play sport with his friends. They would run and jump and throw balls. One day, Timmy and his friends went to the park to play. They wanted to play soccer, but they did not have a ball. So, they looked around the park to gather things they could use. They found a big stick and some leaves, but they were not good for playing soccer. They were patient and kept looking until they found an old ball. They were so happy and played soccer all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she went to the park with her mom. She saw a bird's nest in a tree and asked her mom, "What is that?"

"That is a bird's nest," replied her mom. "The bird lays eggs in there."

Lily looked at the nest and saw a small rod inside. "Why is there a stick in there?" she asked.

"That's a regular part of the nest," explained her mom. "The bird uses it to make the nest stronger."

Lily thought it was amazing that birds could make their own homes. She said, "I wish I could build a nest like that."

"You can build a nest with your toys," said her mom. "But you can't lay eggs in it!" They both laughed and continued to enjoy their day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mom brought home a new dishwasher. It was big and shiny, and Lily thought it was so cool.

As they were washing dishes, Lily's mom told her a story about how she and Lily's dad got married. Lily listened carefully as her mom explained how they had a big party with lots of dancing and yummy food.

Lily thought it was the most original story she had ever heard. She couldn't wait to grow up and have her own party with dancing and yummy food, just like her mom and dad did. And maybe, just maybe, she could use the new dishwasher to help clean up after the party.

Once there was a cat that liked to skip. He skipped around the house, everywhere he went. The cat was very happy and he enjoyed his skipping.

One day he met a dog and the dog said, "Why do you skip?" The cat said, "I skip because it brings me joy."

The dog was very ignorant and he said, "Why do you do something so silly?"

The cat wasn't mad, instead he said, "Skipping brings me joy and it's fun. I don't understand why you don't join me."

The dog didn't understand the joy that skipping could bring, so he just watched the cat skipping around and around. But eventually, he gave in and joined in. They both had a lot of fun skipping around the house, and everyone was happy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Amy. One day, her mommy came up to her and said, "Amy, I have a special surprise for you!"

Amy was so excited. Her mommy said, "I have invited a dreammaker to visit your house. He will make your biggest dreams come true!"

Amy was delighted and couldn't wait for the dreammaker to arrive. But, when he did, Amy's mom said, "Dreams don't come free, Amy. It will be a tough task to make your dreams come true. You will have to work really hard but it will be so worth it!"

Amy was scared. She didn't know if she could do it. But, being brave and trusting her mommy, she said, "I'll try my best!"

The dreammaker smiled, and began telling Amy all the things she must do to make her dream come true. They made a plan and then the dreammaker said, "Now all you have to do is stay determined and keep working hard! I'm sure your dreams will come true eventually."

So Amy kept working hard and, sure enough, her dreams began coming true one by one. She was so proud of herself for working so hard!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Ayla. She was three years old, and she played in her yard all day long. One day, when Ayla was playing, she found an interesting wire in the grass. It was light, and it sparkled in the sun.

Ayla was so curious about the wire that she went to find her mom. "What is this, Mommy?" she asked, holding up the wire.

"It's a wire, Ayla," Mommy said. "It's made of metal. It's used to carry electricity and power things like lights."

Ayla thought it was amazing. She asked if she could keep it and Mommy said yes. From then on, Ayla kept the wire in her pocket and took it everywhere she went. Whenever Ayla went somewhere dark, she would take out the wire, and it would give off a warm light.

Ayla was very happy with her new wire and named it Bob. Whenever she was sad, she looked at Bob and it always made her smile.

Ayla and Bob were best friends, and they stayed together forever!

Mia and Leo are friends. They like to play with toys and eat snacks. One day, Mia has a peanut. She likes peanuts. They are crunchy and salty. Leo does not have a peanut. He wants a peanut. He is jealous of Mia.

"Can I have your peanut?" Leo asks Mia.

"No, it is mine. You have a cracker. Eat your cracker," Mia says.

"But I want a peanut. Please, Mia, give me your peanut," Leo begs.

"No, no, no. Go away, Leo. Leave me alone," Mia says. She puts the peanut in her mouth and chews.

Leo is sad and angry. He does not like Mia. He does not want to be her friend. He thinks Mia is mean and selfish. He runs away from Mia and cries.

Mia hears Leo cry. She feels sorry for Leo. She does not want to make him cry. She does not want to lose her friend. She spits out the peanut and runs after Leo.

"Leo, Leo, wait. I am sorry. I was mean. You can have my peanut. Here, take it," Mia says. She gives Leo the peanut.

Leo stops crying. He looks at Mia and the peanut. He smiles. He takes the peanut and says, "Thank you, Mia. You are a good friend. I am sorry, too. I was jealous. Can we share the peanut?"

Mia nods. She smiles, too. She says, "Yes, we can share the peanut. And we can share the cracker, too. And we can play with toys and eat snacks. We are friends, Leo."

Leo and Mia hug. They share the peanut and the cracker. They play with toys and eat snacks. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big bus. Every day, it was busy taking people to their destinations. One day, it drove to a big town.

When the bus arrived, a little girl came out. Her name was Lola. She had been on an adventure and was making her way back home.

As she walked, she met an old woman. "Good morning child," said the old woman. "What brings you here?

Lola smiled and replied, "I am returning from a very long journey. I went to a magical place and had so many adventures! I even heard a story about a beautiful princess!"

The old woman smiled and said, "That sounds like a wonderful experience. I am sure you enjoyed it."

Lola nodded in agreement, then said goodbye to the old woman and continued her journey. Over the next few days, she made her way back home, remembering the busy days on the bus and the magical stories she had heard.

Lily and Ben were playing in the garden. They saw a big vine with many red fruits on it. They wanted to try the fruits. They looked very delicious.

"Can we pick some fruits, Mom?" Lily asked.

"Yes, but be careful. The vine is high and the fruits are heavy. Don't drop them on your head," Mom said.

Lily and Ben climbed on a ladder. They reached for the fruits. They picked some and put them in a basket. They were happy.

But then, Ben saw a very big fruit. He wanted it. He stretched his arm. He grabbed the fruit. But it was too heavy for him. He could not hold it. He dropped it.

"Ouch!" Ben cried. The fruit fell on his head. It hurt him. He was sad.

Lily saw what happened. She felt sorry for Ben. She climbed down the ladder. She gave him a hug. She gave him a fruit from the basket.

"Here, Ben. Have this fruit. It is delicious. And it is not too heavy. You will feel better," Lily said.

Ben smiled. He took the fruit. He bit it. It was sweet and juicy. He liked it. He thanked Lily.

"Thank you, Lily. You are a good sister. I am sorry I dropped the fruit. I was greedy. I will share with you," Ben said.

Lily and Ben hugged again. They ate the fruits. They were happy. Mom smiled. She was proud of them.

There was a boy named Tim. He had a modern toy car. One day, Tim went to the store with his mom. He saw a candy he wanted. But Tim did not have a penny to buy it.

Tim started to complain. He wanted the candy so much. His mom said, "No candy today, Tim." Tim was sad. He went back home with his mom.

At home, Tim played with his modern toy car. He smiled and forgot about the candy. Tim's mom was happy. She knew Tim didn't need the candy to be happy.

Once there was a little toddler called Emma. She loved to paint and make things bright and full of colour.

One day Emma went to the store to buy some paint. She pointed to the different colours, but she was getting very weak from standing for too long.

So Emma's mom scooped her up in her arms and said "Don't worry princess, we will get the paint later".

Emma wasn't sure what to do, so she started to cry. But her mom told her "Don't worry, sweetheart. We will get some paint soon and make lovely pictures together."

Emma brightened up right away. She knew that soon she would have lots of lovely bright colours to paint with.

Tom and Sue are husband and wife. They live in a small house with a big garden. They like to grow flowers and vegetables in the garden. Sometimes they share their vegetables with their neighbors.

One day, Tom wants to make a salad for lunch. He goes to the garden and picks some lettuce, tomatoes and carrots. He washes them and puts them in a big bowl. He asks Sue to help him make the dressing.

Sue is busy reading a book. She does not want to help Tom. She says, "No, thank you. I am not hungry. I want to read my book."

Tom is angry. He says, "Sue, you are being naughty. You should help me in the kitchen. We are a team. We should share the work."

Sue refuses to listen to Tom. She says, "I don't care. I like my book more than your salad. Go away and leave me alone."

Tom is sad. He does not like to fight with Sue. He loves his wife. He decides to eat the salad by himself. He hopes that Sue will change her mind and join him later. He thinks that maybe she needs some time to calm down. He wishes that they could be happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a small, fragile girl. She loved visiting the lake near her home. Every time she went, she could hear birds singing and the wind whistle. She loved to sit by the lake and watch the ducks swimming in the water.

One day, when she went to the lake, she brought her pocket whistle. She held onto it tightly and blew hard, making the most beautiful sound. The birds stopped singing and all the ducks turned to look at her. The girl felt so special and happy.

She kept blowing, and the ducks swam closer and closer. When they reached her, she put the whistle away and gave each one a piece of bread. The ducks were so happy! Every time she visited the lake after, they would come swimming to her, reminding her of that special day.

Once upon a time, there was a smelly dog named Spot. Spot loved to play in the mud and roll around in the dirt. He was a very happy dog, but sometimes he would get very dirty.

One day, Spot was playing outside and found a big pile of mud. He jumped in the mud and rolled around, getting very smelly. Then, Spot went back to the house to show his family how much fun he had. But when he got home, his family did not like the smell.

Spot's family told him that he needed to take a bath. Spot did not like baths, but he knew he had to get clean. He felt regret for getting so smelly. Spot took a bath and was clean again. From that day on, Spot tried to stay clean and not get too smelly.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly man who used to take a walk every day. One day, he felt an itch on his nose and was about to scratch it when suddenly he spotted a young boy and girl nearby playing tag!

The elderly man was quite excited to see the children playing and laughing together, so he decided not to scratch his nose. He watched them as they ran around and he smiled.

After a few minutes, the children's mother noticed the elderly man watching the children and asked him why he was there. The elderly man replied, "I'm just here to see how lovely you and your children are behaving."

The mother was pleased and thanked him for not scratching his nose while the children were playing. She realized what a kind gesture this was from the elderly man, and she thanked him again before he left.

The story has a moral value - it is important to always behave in a kind and courteous way, even when you have an itch.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play all day and never wanted to go to sleep. Her mommy always told her to go to her bedroom and sleep, but Lily was too lazy.

One day, her mommy said, "Lily, you have to study for your school tomorrow." Lily replied, "I don't want to study, I want to play." Her mommy said, "No, you have to study first and then you can play." Lily went to her bedroom and started to study.

After a while, Lily's mommy came to her bedroom and said, "Lily, good job studying. Now you can go play." Lily was so happy and went outside to play with her friends. From that day on, Lily knew that she had to study first before she could play.

Once upon a time, there was a delicate boat floating in the ocean. It was getting tired so it decided to take a rest. The boat gently floated to a beautiful harbor. The harbor was full of many boats like the delicate one. The delicate boat was happy to be in the harbor. All the boats rested in the harbor together. There was a nice breeze blowing. Everyone was happy and safe in the harbor. The delicate boat went to sleep in the harbor and felt cozy and content.

The boats stayed in the harbor for a long time to get some rest. After a while, the boats started to wake up and were ready to sail again. The delicate boat was happy to be in the harbor and thanked them all for the peace it had found.

The delicate boat was so happy that it had found a place to rest in the harbor. It said goodbye to the other boats and started sailing again. The delicate boat went on many adventures, but it would always remember the peaceful moments it had spent in the harbor.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big dog. The dog is black and white. The dog has a red collar. The dog is a guard. He works with a man. The man wears a blue suit.

"Hello, dog!" Lily says. She wants to pet the dog. Tom is scared. He hides behind Lily.

"Be careful, kids," the man says. "This dog is not for petting. He is a guard. He helps me catch bad people."

"Wow, really?" Lily says. She is not scared. She likes the dog. "What is his name?"

"His name is Spot," the man says. "He is a good dog. But he is also messy. He likes to dig holes and roll in the mud."

Lily and Tom laugh. They see the dog's paws. They are dirty. They see the dog's fur. It is muddy.

"Can we play with Spot?" Lily asks. "We don't mind if he is messy."

The man smiles. He likes the kids. He says yes. Lily and Tom are happy. They play with Spot. They throw a ball. They run and jump. They have fun.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very creative boy. He liked to play in the sand and make fun things.

One day, Tim found a big pit in his backyard. He thought it would be fun to put things in the pit. He put rocks, sticks, and leaves in the pit. He also put some of his toys in the pit. Tim liked to watch the things fall into the pit.

Tim's mom saw him playing in the pit. She told him to be careful and not fall in. Tim listened to his mom and played safely. He was happy to have a fun pit to play in. And that is how Tim found a new way to be creative with the pit in his backyard.

Jim was very frightened when he arrived at the barber's shop. It was his first time getting a haircut! He didn't want his mum to leave him alone with the strange man.

"Don't worry," said the barber. He smiled and handed Jim a big lollipop. "I'll look after you and give you the best haircut ever."

Jim's frown disappeared and he couldn't help but be excited. The barber put a cape around him, and the chair felt like a magic carpet ride. Soon, Jim felt his hair being trimmed, and the barber even gave him some funny glasses to look through. When Jim looked in the mirror, he saw the best haircut ever! He was so happy, he forgot all about being scared.

Mum smiled when she saw Jim. She was so proud of him for sitting so still for such a long time.

"Well done, my boy!" she said, giving him a big hug.

Jim smiled and couldn't wait to show his friends his new haircut.

Once upon a time, there was a tall bear. He had a big fluffy tail. The bear loved to go on adventures. One day he went to the forest to find something new and exciting.

As he was walking, he heard a sound. Something was squeezing his tail. The bear looked around, but he couldn't see what was squeezing his tail. He jumped and looked around to find the culprit. He saw a small rabbit in the bushes.

The bear asked the rabbit why it was squeezing his tail. The rabbit said it was because it was scared. The bear smiled and said it was ok. He asked the rabbit if it wanted to come on an adventure with him. The rabbit hopped up and down with excitement.

The bear and the rabbit had lots of fun exploring the forest. They looked in every bush and every tree. The bear would protect the rabbit if he got scared or hugged his tail if it was shaking. They both made sure to have a very fun and safe adventure.

When it was time to go home, the bear and the rabbit said goodbye to each other. The bear thought to himself that although using his tail was a bit uncomfortable, he was glad it helped the rabbit feel safe enough to explore.

Jill was in the park. She saw a really high tree. She wanted to jump up to the top. But it looked really difficult. Suddenly, she saw a razor at the base of the tree. She thought it might make it easier to climb up.

"I can try and climb up with the razor," said Jill.

So she grabbed the razor and tried to pull herself up the tree. But it was still too difficult.

Suddenly, her big brother, Jake, came over. He saw what she was doing.

"Come on, Jill. I'll help you," said Jake.

Jake started to hold the razor for Jill. Together, they carefully climbed up the tree. Jill and Jake high-fived each other at the top.

"I did it! I jumped to the top of the tree! Thanks, Big Brother," said Jill.

"Anytime, little Sis," said Jake.

They celebrated at the top of the tree for a few minutes before carefully climbing down. Jill was so happy she could jump to the top of the tree with Jake's help.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He had a bike with pedals that he loved to ride. One day, he saw a girl crying on the sidewalk. He asked her what was wrong.

The girl said she was lost and didn't know how to get home. Timmy didn't know where she lived, but he wanted to help. He asked his mom for help, and she called the police. The police found the girl's home and took her there safely.

Timmy felt happy that he could help someone who was lost. He didn't want to be ignorant and not help someone who needed it. From that day on, he always tried to be kind and helpful to others.

Once upon a time, there was a deep green gate. It was very tall and strong, and it protected the garden from anything bad that might try to get in.

One day, a little girl wanted to go into the garden. She wanted to see the flowers and trees and feel the sunshine. She tried to push the gate open, but it wouldn't move. It was too strong!

Suddenly, she heard a gentle voice say, "Hello little one. To get into the garden, you must shut the gate." She looked around, but nobody was there. She tried pushing the gate open again, and this time it moved!

The little girl ran into the garden, so excited to explore. Every day, she came back and shut the gate before she left.

After a while, the little girl was so big that she could no longer open the deep green gate. But whenever she saw it, she remembered all the adventures she had in the garden.

Once there was a girl named Mabel. She was only three years old and loved playing with her friends.

One day, Mabel went to the store with her mom. Inside, her mom bought a carton of oats for breakfast. But on the way home, Mabel got very nervous. She forgot to bring the oats.

So Mabel went back to the store. She asked her mom to help her find the oats. And when they found the oats, they both hugged each other.

Mabel was so happy! She never wanted to forget the oats again. And so, she made sure to always remember them, each time they went shopping.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Olive. She was only three years old and always wanted to learn more.
One day, Olive's mommy told her that if she wanted to learn, she had to work hard. Olive was so excited and began practicing her ABC's and counting numbers right away!
"Mommy, what else can I learn?" asked Olive.
Her mommy replied "One day, Olive, you'll learn how to read and write if you keep working hard".
Olive smiled and kept practicing her ABC's and counting. She knew she had to be very determined.
Once Olive felt confident in her ABC's and counting, she asked her mommy again "Can I learn something else now?"
Her mommy smiled and said "Yes Olive, you can learn how to ride a bike".
Olive was so excited she started practicig that very day. At the end of the week, she had learned how to ride a bike! Olive felt so proud of herself for learning how to do something so hard.

The moral of the story: with hard work, anything is possible!

Once there was a playful little boy named Patrick. He loved to play games and go on adventures every day. One day he was playing tag with his friends in the park when suddenly the sky went dark and it started to rain.

Patrick began to worry and said to his friends, "What shall we do now?" His friends replied, "Let's run home before we get too wet."

So they ran back to Patrick's house and when they got there they saw that the lights were on. His mom was in the kitchen making dinner. Patrick was so relieved that he ran up to her and hugged her.

His mom said, "Surprise! I'm having a magical dinner for us tonight." Patrick was so excited that he could barely contain himself!

The dinner was delicious and afterwards the kids decided to go play a board game. Patrick wanted to play the game so badly that he accidentally knocked the pieces off the table. Everyone gasped but then his mom said, "It's okay Patrick, don't worry. We can set it up again."

When the game was set up, Patrick started to play and he was so happy. Suddenly, something scary happened. A hand came out of the board game and it started to strike at Patrick. He screamed and backed up quickly.

His mom said, "It's okay Patrick, it's just a nightmare. Nightmares can't hurt you."

Patrick

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Joe. Joe had a lot of cool equipment. One of the pieces of equipment was a big, blue balloon.

One day, Joe wanted to pass the balloon to a friend. But the balloon was so big and it was hard to pass. Joe tried again and again, but he just couldn't get it to work.

Suddenly, Joe had an idea! He connected two pieces of equipment together to make a handle on the balloon. That made it easy to pass.

Joe quickly grabbed the handle and passed the balloon to his friend. His friend was so happy and they played with the balloon until the sun went down!

Once upon a time, there was a naughty little boy. His name was Todd. He lived in a big, blue house with his family.

One day, Todd saw a cherry tree in front of his house. The cherries looked so yummy, he wanted to try one! He climbed up the tree and picked one. "Mmm," said Todd. "This cherry is so sweet!"

Just then, Todd heard someone shouting. It was his mom! "Todd!" she said in a harsh voice. "Get down from that tree! You shouldn't steal cherries!"

Todd knew he had done something wrong. He slowly climbed down from the tree, and went to apologize to his mom. She hugged him and said: "Todd, you shouldn't have stolen the cherry. Next time, just ask me and I will get it for you."

Todd smiled and hugged his mom tightly. From then on, Todd knew never to steal again.

Once upon a time there was a purple dog. It was the most beautiful dog ever. Everywhere the dog went people stopped to admire the pup. One day the dog had an idea. He wanted to borrow some ash from a neighbor. So the dog trotted over to the neighbor's door and knocked. The neighbor was not happy to see the dog but let him in anyway. The dog asked for some ash, but the neighbor said no. The dog begged, but the neighbor said no again - so the dog left without any ash.

Days went by, and the dog continued to be admired. One day, the purple pup was walking along a path when he spotted the ash from the neighbor. It was small piles of ash all over the ground. The dog quickly realized the neighbor had been trying to protect the ash by keeping it away from the pup. He was happy to have finally found the ash he had been searching for.

The dog used the ash to look even better. Everywhere he went, people stopped and said he was the most beautiful pup in the land. The dog was very proud of his finds and the purple ash that made him look even more beautiful.

Molly the monkey was very clever. She had a plan to drive the skeleton away. She went to a magical store and bought a shiny red car. She got in and put on her seatbelt.

She drove around and around the skeleton, making loud noises and honking her horn. The skeleton was scared and ran away in a hurry. Molly felt so proud of herself.

Molly continued to drive around town, honking her horn and having lots of fun. Everywhere she went, she showed that she was a very clever monkey.

Soon it was time for Molly to go home, but she wanted to drive around just a little bit more. So, she drove to the beach, where she had lots of fun. She drove around in the sand and splashed in the sea.

At last, Molly drove back home, tired and happy. She had had a wonderful day and she was proud of her clever driving skills.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat candy because it was sweet. Her mommy would always buy her candy and she would own a lot of it.

One day, Lily was playing with her toys and found a stuffed animal with a soft texture. She hugged it tightly and loved how it felt. She wanted to take it with her everywhere she went and own it forever.

At bedtime, Lily snuggled with her stuffed animal and ate some candy. She felt happy because she owned two things she loved - something sweet and something soft. She fell asleep with a smile on her face.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wander around her garden and look at all the pretty flowers. One day, she found a big squash hiding behind a bush.

Lily picked up the squash and showed it to her mom. "Look, Mommy! I found a big squash!" she said with a smile.

Her mom was proud of Lily's successful discovery. "Wow, Lily! That's a really big squash. Maybe we can make some delicious soup with it," her mom said.

Lily was happy to have found something new and exciting in her garden. She continued to wander around, looking for more treasures to discover.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play with her toys and eat candy. One day, Lily went to the store with her mommy. They walked around and looked at all the things in the store.

Suddenly, Lily saw a boy who was being very naughty. He was throwing things and making a mess. Lily's mommy told her to stay away from the naughty boy.

When they were done shopping, Lily and her mommy went to the exit. They saw a man who was wearing a big bow tie. Lily thought it looked funny and she laughed. Then, they went home and had some ice cream. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a mom and a dad who were very happy together. They loved each other very much and wanted to be together forever. One day, they decided to raise their hands and say nice things to each other in front of all their family and friends. This special thing was called a marriage.

The mom and dad were so excited and had a big party to share the news with everyone they knew. But then one day, the mom got angry. She was mad and yelled at the dad, and they started to fight.

The mom and dad loved each other, but their fighting was causing them a lot of sadness. They decided to talk to each other and try to understand why the mom was so angry. After talking, the mom and dad hugged and said sorry to each other.

The mom and dad worked hard and showed each other how much they loved each other. Even though sometimes they still got angry, they kept trying to talk and understand and found peace in their marriage.
The End.

Once there was a man called Steve who had a truck. He loved his truck very much. Everyday he would take it out and drive around the town.

One day, he had to load something very large and heavy. He was very troubled, because the truck had no sides! He didn't know how he was going to load this large item.

But then he had an idea! He bought some wood and built sides around the back part of his truck. Now he had a big space to load the large item.

He was so happy! After he loaded the item, he drove around town with a smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. Jack had a brother named Timmy. Timmy was Jack's best friend. One day, Jack wanted to visit Timmy's house. Jack asked his mom if they could go. His mom said yes!

When they got to Timmy's house, Jack saw a toy that he really liked. Timmy said it was an original toy that his grandpa gave him. Jack thought it was really cool. They played with the toy together and had so much fun.

After they played, Jack and Timmy's mom gave them some cookies to eat. They were so yummy! Jack had a great time visiting his brother's house and playing with his original toy.

Once upon a time there was a proud little girl and her staff. Every day the girl would play by the nearby river and splash in the water. She loved to splash and make big waves.

One day, as the little girl was playing in the river, she heard a voice. The voice was her mother, calling her name.

"Come here my little girl," her mama said.

The little girl ran to her mama and asked, "What do you need, Mama?"

Her mama said, "There is something special that I need you to do, and I need your help."

The little girl looked at her staff and said, â€œI will do anything you need, Mama!â€

So the mama gave her daughter a big job. She needed her daughter to help her plant flowers around their house.

The little girl was so proud that her mama chose her to help. She grabbed her staff and hopped back and forth, planting each flower with a big splash. In the end, the little girl's mama was very proud of her daughter, and she thanked her for all the hard work.

The little girl smiled, knowing that she had done a really good job.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved music and always wanted to play the flute. One day, her mommy bought her a flute and she was so happy.

Lily tried to play it, but it didn't sound good. She asked her mommy why it didn't sound like the music she heard. Her mommy said, "You have to examine the flute and see if everything is okay."

Lily looked at the flute and found out that one of the holes was covered. She fixed it and tried to play again. This time, it sounded beautiful! She was so successful in playing the flute.

The moral of the story is that if you want to do something, you have to examine everything to make sure it's right. If you do that, you can be successful in anything you want to do.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man who lived on an island. He had a big house and many toys. The man was happy, but he wanted a friend.

One day, a little boy came to the island in a boat. The boy said, "Hello! I want to know about this island." The wealthy man smiled and said, "I will show you around."

They walked and talked. The little boy liked the island and the man's big house. The wealthy man asked, "Do you want to be my friend?" The little boy said, "Yes! I would love to be your friend."

From that day on, the wealthy man and the little boy were best friends. They played with the toys and had fun on the island. They both knew that they were very lucky to have each other.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to look at the stars at night. They had a big window in their room where they could see the sky. Sometimes they saw a shooting star and made a wish.

One night, they saw a very bright star that was bigger than the others. They wondered what it was and wanted to know more. They asked their mom, who was reading a book in the living room.

"Mom, mom, what is that big star?" they said, running to her.

"That is not a star, my loves. That is the moon. It is very far away, but sometimes it looks bigger and brighter. It is called a full moon," mom explained.

"Wow, the moon is so pretty. Can we go there?" Lily asked.

"No, we cannot go there. It is too far and too cold. But we can look at it and enjoy its light," mom said.

"Can we touch it?" Tom asked.

"No, we cannot touch it. It is too high and too hard. But we can imagine how it feels and what it is made of," mom said.

Lily and Tom were very curious and had many questions. They kept asking mom about the moon and the stars. Mom was very patient and answered them as best as she could. She was happy to see them interested in the sky.

But soon it was time for bed. Mom told them to brush their teeth and put on their pajamas. Lily and Tom did not want to stop looking at the moon. They begged mom to let them stay up a little longer.

"Please, mom, please. Just five more minutes. We want to see the moon," they said.

"Sorry, my loves, but you have to go to bed now. It is late and you need to sleep. The moon will be there tomorrow night, too. And maybe you will see a shooting star and make a wish," mom said.

Lily and Tom were not happy. They did not want to miss the moon. They started to scream and cry. They threw a tantrum and kicked their feet.

"Stop, stop, stop. That is enough. You are being very naughty and rude. You have to listen to mom and do as I say. Go to bed now, or you will be in trouble," mom said, sternly.

Lily and Tom realized they had gone too far. They saw mom's angry face and heard her loud voice. They felt scared and sorry. They stopped screaming and crying. They said sorry to mom and gave her a hug.

"Sorry, mom. We love you. We love the moon, too. But we love you more," they said.

Mom smiled and hugged them back. She was not angry anymore. She was glad they apologized and calmed down. She kissed them good night and tucked them in.

"Good night, my loves. I love you, too. I love the moon, too. But I love you more," she said.

She turned off the light and left the room. Lily and Tom closed their eyes and fell asleep. They dreamed of the moon and the stars. And they hoped to see a shooting star and make a wish.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Sam. He was three years old and liked to play with his friends.

One day, Sam and his friends were playing hide and seek in the park. All of a sudden, Sam saw something shiny in the grass. It was a big, yellow lemon! He wanted to pick it up, but he knew he shouldn't.

He ran back to his friends and asked if anyone knew whose lemon it was. His friend Petey said, "I think it's Mrs. Smith's lemon tree. She won't be happy if you take it!"

Sam felt guilty, but he couldn't resist the temptation. He slowly gained the lemon and put it in his pocket.

Sam continued to play with his friends, but he couldn't stop thinking about the lemon. After a while, he decided to do the right thing and take the lemon back to Mrs. Smith.

When Sam got to Mrs. Smith's house, she was very pleased. She said, "Thank you for being a good person, Sam. You did the right thing."

Sam smiled. He was glad that he learned that it's always better to do the right thing.

One day, Sally was running in the park with her hoop. Suddenly, she saw a cute little squirrel with a long tail. Sally was so excited that she wanted to play with it.

She ran closer and the squirrel stopped. Sally smiled and said, "Hi Squirrel! Can I play with you?"

The squirrel just looked at her and didn't answer. Then another squirrel came closer, hopped around the first one and then ran away. Sally smiled again and said, "Please, can I play with you?"

The first squirrel looked at Sally and then hopped to the hoop. Sally was so happy that she clapped her hands and started to play with the squirrel. They played tag with the hoop, hopping around in circles and having lots of fun.

In the end, they both stopped. Sally thanked the squirrel and ran off home. She had lots of fun playing with her new friend in the park.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Alison. She was hungry and had nothing to eat. One day she found a bag of gold lying in the street. She was so excited and quickly picked it up.

Alison couldn't believe her luck and started to think of all the things she could buy. But suddenly a man came running up to her. He shouted "Hey! That's mine - give it back!"

Alison was scared, but she decided to listen to the man and give him back the bag of gold. The man thanked her and said "you have done the right thing, but as a reward I will give you a packet of crisps".

Alison was so happy and opened the packet of crisps. She was no longer hungry and thanked the man, who smiled and said "listen young Alison, the gold is the last thing you want, remember that".

And Alison happily skipped off home, knowing she had done the right thing.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl. She loved playing outside in the fresh air.

One day while playing, she saw a mud puddle. She was so excited. She started jumping into the mud. Splat! Splat!

Suddenly, something thin and white slithered out of the mud. The little girl was surprised.

She jumped out of the mud and said, â€œWhat is that?â€

The thin white thing looked up at her and said, â€œIâ€™m a little snake. I was taking a nap in the mud.â€

The little girl and the snake played together all day. They had so much fun! When it was time to go home, the little girl said goodbye and gave the snake a big hug.

The snake said, â€œI had a great surprise today. It was fun!â€

The little girl smiled and said, â€œMe too! See you next time.â€ And she ran home all full of excitement.

Yesterday, Maria's Mommy gave her a special box. Inside the box was a messy surprise. Maria pulled it out and ripped the paper. She was very happy to find a puppy! Maria hugged the puppy and the puppy licked her face. Maria giggled with joy.

Maria cuddled the puppy all day. They played tag and chased each other around the yard. When it was time for bed, Maria put the puppy in its bed. They said goodnight and Maria went to hers.

This morning, Maria ran to the puppy and they played again. But the puppy got so excited that he tore all the paper off the box! It was very messy, but Maria still loved her puppy. She said, ''It's okay. We just have to play cleaner games.''

The end.

Ralph was clumsy and he loved to rush around. He remembered when his dad told him that he should never rush, but he didn't listen.

One day, Ralph rushed to his bedroom and pulled out a toy box. He opened it and saw a bell inside. Ralph quickly picked up the bell and rang it.

His mom's voice came from downstairs, "Ralph, it's time for dinner. Don't rush too much!"

Ralph quickly put the bell back in the toy box, closed it and ran downstairs. He quickly sat at the dinner table and smiled. He was ashamed that he was rushing again.

His dad saw him and said, "Ralph, remember - it's OK to rush sometimes, but it's important to take your time too."

Ralph nodded and said, "I'll try to remember, dad."

Since then, Ralph has learned to be less clumsy and to take time to enjoy the things he does.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted a luxury toy very badly. But her mommy said no. The little girl started to scream. It was very loud. All the other people in the store were embarrassed. Excitement soon filled the air when the little girl's mommy said yes! She was very happy and the mommy was very proud. So the little girl got her luxury toy and they all went home with big smiles on their faces. The End.

Lily liked to splash in the water. She had a big tub in her room with many toys. She liked to make waves and bubbles and sing songs. Sometimes her mom or dad would join her and splash with her.

One day, Lily had to go to the office with her mom. Her mom had to work on her computer and talk to people. Lily had to be patient and quiet. She brought some books and crayons, but she soon got bored. She wanted to splash in the water.

She saw a big bottle of water on a table. It looked like fun. She went to the table and tried to open the bottle. But it was too hard. She pushed and pulled and twisted, but nothing happened. She got angry and kicked the bottle.

The bottle fell off the table and broke on the floor. Water splashed everywhere. Lily was surprised and scared. She heard her mom shout, "Lily, what did you do?"

Lily started to cry. She ran to her mom and hugged her. Her mom was wet and angry, but also worried. She said, "Lily, you can't splash water in the office. It's not safe. You could hurt yourself or others. You have to be patient and listen to me."

Lily said, "I'm sorry, mom. I wanted to splash in the water. I like to splash in the water. Can we go home and splash in the water?"

Her mom sighed and said, "Maybe later, Lily. But first we have to clean up this mess. And then we have to say sorry to the people in the office. Can you do that?"

Lily nodded and said, "Yes, mom. I can do that. I love you, mom."

Her mom smiled and said, "I love you too, Lily. But next time, please don't splash water in the office."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her dolls and have tea parties with her stuffed animals. One day, Lily's mom told her it was time for a haircut. Lily didn't want a haircut because she loved her long hair that she could shake back and forth.

But Lily's mom said, "Your hair is getting too long and it's making you hot. You'll feel much better with a nice haircut."

Lily didn't like the sound of that, but she trusted her mom. So, they went to the hair salon and Lily sat in the big chair. The hairdresser started to cut Lily's hair and Lily was nervous. But then, the hairdresser showed Lily how she could shake her new haircut and it made her feel better.

Lily was so happy with her new haircut that she couldn't stop shaking her head and saying, "Thank you, Mom!"

Once there was three friends, a dog, a frog and a mouse, who wanted to find a magical stand. So the three friends marched across the fields and forests, bravely looking for the stand. Suddenly, they heard a noise, and there in front of them was the stand. It was tall and mysterious and the three friends were so excited!

But the stand refused to move no matter how hard they tried. It was very stubborn. The mouse pulled, the frog jumped and the dog barked, but the stand wouldn't budge. All their efforts had failed!

At last, the brave three friends had an idea. They started to sing and dance around the stand and it began to move. It had finally worked! Together, the three friends marched around the stand and celebrated their success.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends decided to play a game of catch. Timmy tried his best to catch the ball, but it kept slipping out of his hands.

Suddenly, the ball flew over Timmy's head and landed in a nearby net. Timmy ran over to the net and tried to get the ball out, but it was stuck. He pulled and pulled, but the ball wouldn't budge.

Timmy's friends came over to help him. They all tried to get the ball out of the net, but it was no use. Timmy's arm started to hurt from pulling so hard. Just when they thought they would never get the ball back, Timmy's big brother came to the rescue. He easily got the ball out of the net and gave it back to Timmy. Timmy was so happy and grateful to his brother for helping him.

Mary and her brother Sam love to play together. One day they decided to clap their hands and see who could clap the loudest. Sam clapped extra loudly, and Mary clapped extra fast.

Mama heard the noise and came in to see what was going on. She saw Mary and Sam clapping, and she smiled.
