Once there was a little girl who was very fearful. One night she heard a loud noise coming from her bedroom. It sounded like something was inside her room. She didn't want to look, but she was very curious. So she slowly opened her bedroom door and peeked in.

Inside she saw a big, scary computer. It was making strange noises and flashing all sorts of colors. The little girl was so scared, she quickly shut the door and ran into her mom's room.

Her mom hugged her tightly and asked her what was wrong. The little girl told her mom about the scary computer, and her mom said it must just be a dream.

So, the little girl and her mom snuggled together and went back to sleep. The next morning, when the little girl opened her bedroom door, the computer was gone. She smiled, relieved that it was all just a dream.

Once there was a chubby bee who liked to zoom. He zoomed around his garden all day long, looking for places to explore. One day, he noticed a vase sitting on the ledge of the garden wall. He was very curious, so he zipped over to have a closer look. The glass was shiny and there were lots of pretty flowers inside. He wanted to see the flowers better, so he zoomed around to the other side and touched the vase. Suddenly, it tipped over, and the flowers and water spilled out! He quickly buzzed away, worried that he had made a mess. But then he heard a voiceâ€"it was his momma! She said, "Don't worry, my little bee. We can fix it." And so they did, with a little help from Momma. After all the flowers were back in the vase, they both admired it and then the chubby bee continued to zoom around the garden. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a fisherman named Tom. He liked to plan his day by the sea. One day, Tom was confused. He could not find his net to catch fish. He looked and looked, but it was gone.

Tom asked his friend, Sam. "Did you see my net?" Sam shook his head. "No, I didn't see it." Tom was sad. He could not catch fish without his net. But Sam had an idea. "Let's look together," he said.

Tom and Sam looked all around. They looked near the sea and in the sand. At last, they found the net under a big rock. Tom was so happy! Now he could catch fish again. Tom and Sam went to the sea and caught many fish together. They were the best of friends.

Mum took Sally to the shop. There was a big bookcase. "That's silly!" laughed Sally. Mum smiled too. She took Sally's hand and they walked over to the bookcase. It was so big Sally could hardly see to the top. She couldn't take it home as it was so big. Mum took some books off the shelf and gave them to Sally. She was very excited. "Can I keep them?" she asked. Mum said, "Yes, but we have to take them home so you can read them". Sally put the books in her pocket and gave Mum a big hug. She was so happy. Mum and Sally went home with the books to read. Sally loved her new books and took care of them. She looked at the funny bookcase every time she went to the shop.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, while they were playing, they saw a monster! The monster was big and scary, and it started to run after them.

Timmy and his friends were very scared, but they knew they had to be brave. They decided to run away from the monster as fast as they could. They ran and ran until they were far away from the monster.

After they were safe, Timmy and his friends talked about what had happened. They decided that they wanted to be famous for being brave and running away from the monster. So, they told everyone in their town about their adventure. Soon, everyone knew about Timmy and his friends and how they had run away from the scary monster.

Once upon a time, a boy named Timmy had a big drum. He loved to bang it loud, but his mom said it was too noisy. One day, Timmy decided to stir up some fun by playing his drum outside. He banged it loud and danced around, making all the neighbors smile. Suddenly, a group of kids came over and asked if they could play too. Timmy was happy to share his drum and they all banged it loud together. They had so much fun, they decided to start a band and play for everyone in the town. And that's how Timmy and his friends became the best drummers in the land. The end.

One winter, there was a sad girl. She wanted to write something, but she didn't know what to write. She thought and thought, but nothing came to her. Then she had an idea! She would write about the winter.

She looked around and noticed the cold snow on the ground and the white fluffy clouds in the sky. She thought about the icy wind blowing and the frost adding sparkles to everything. She took out her pen and paper, and started to write. She wrote about all the things she saw and felt outside, everything she was so sad about.

When she was finished, she read it over and smiled. She felt better, like she knew the winter better now. She put her paper away, and went inside to get warm and have a snack.

Once upon a time there was a family who wanted something to be reliable. They went on a search throughout the house until they came to the cupboard. Inside the cupboard was something special, it was the most reliable thing in the house. The family was so happy that they decided to give it to someone else who could use it.

The family gave the cupboard to their neighbor who was also searching for something reliable. The neighbor was so excited that they hugged the family to show their gratitude. The family was glad that they could help out their neighbor and make them happy.

The cupboard was given a new home where it could be relied on for many, many years. And so the family has a happy ending when their reliable cupboard brought everyone a lot of joy.

Once upon a time there was a dolphin who liked to wander. He swam around the ocean every day looking for something new and exciting.

One day the dolphin found something special. The ocean was warm and the sun was shining. The dolphin smiled and knew he had found a special place.

The dolphin decided to explore this special place. He swam around and looked at all the amazing things in the ocean. He could see colourful fish and coral in the warm water.

The dolphin kept swimming and he soon came across a big beach. The sand was so warm on his fins, he just had to stop and take it all in. He stayed for a while and enjoyed the sunshine and the waves.

When he felt it was time to move on, the dolphin returned to the ocean. He decided to wander around some more, so he could find more special things.

He kept swimming and he found many amazing things. But nothing was as special as the warm beach he had found. And so the dolphin kept coming back to this place whenever he wanted to wander.

Once upon a time, there was a small kitty. She lived in a big house all alone. She was sad because she had no one to play with.

One day, she found a strange box outside of her house. Inside the box was a razor. Curious, she took a closer look.

The kitty didn't know what it was, so she decided to settle down and try to figure it out. She tried to move it and she saw a bright light come out of it.

The kitty was very excited and tried to slip the razor past her ear. Suddenly, she felt a strange tingle. She felt so excited and scared at the same time.

The kitty had never felt anything like this before. She had discovered the unknown! She quickly settled into a corner of her house and felt the tingle in her fur. She knew she found something special.

From then on, the kitty was never alone. She had her new razor to keep her company.

One day, a little girl named Sally went with her mom to the store. They wanted to buy a toy for Sally's friend, Tom. Sally was very excited to pick out a toy for him.

In the store, Sally saw many toys. She was careful when looking at each one. She wanted to find the perfect toy for Tom. Then, she saw a toy car with a turn. When she pushed the car, it would go straight and then turn all by itself. Sally knew Tom would love it.

Sally's mom helped her buy the toy car. They took it home and wrapped it in pretty paper. At Tom's birthday party, Sally gave him the gift. Tom was so happy when he saw the car with a turn. They played with the toy car all day and had lots of fun.

Once there was a little girl. She was three years old and her name was Lily. One day, Lily was playing outside. She saw an interesting thing on the ground.

It was very dry and it felt strange. She picked it up and looked at it. It was so interesting that she wanted to keep it.

So, Lily took the thing and ran home. She put the thing in her pocket and went inside.

But when she took the thing out of her pocket later, it had gotten wet! She was very sad and started to cry.

Lily's mom tried to make her feel better, but she couldn't. It was too late. The thing was ruined.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had a terrific problem. She had no money to buy the things that she wanted, and it made her feel very troubled.

One day, her dad came to visit her and gave her a big surprise. He gave her a pile of money and said it was just for her! She was so happy that she jumped up and down with delight.

With the money, she thought of all the fun things that she could buy for herself. But before she had a chance to spend it, something horrible happened. A spark from the fireplace flew out and set the money on fire. The money was burning!

The little girl started to cry because all of her money was gone. Even though she was very disappointed, she knew that the money couldn't buy everything. She had to find another way to get the things she wanted.

John was an anxious little boy. Every day he liked to fly outside and explore. One day, he had an exciting idea. He wanted to fly higher than he ever had before! He got his wings and off he flew, into the sky.

The clouds flew by and John flew faster, with each beat from his wings. He was so close to reaching his goal. Suddenly, he noticed some birds flying much higher and even faster. He wanted to keep up with them!

John was anxious. He hadn't flown this high before, and he didn't know if he could make it. But then he decided to give it a try. He took a deep breath and flew harder than ever. He was so close to the birds now!

Suddenly, John felt like he was floating. He had done it! He had flown higher than before and now he was gliding on the wind. John felt so proud of himself. He had turned his idea into a reality!

Once upon a time there was a bridge. It was very smooth. All the animals wanted to walk on top of it.

One day a little mouse was walking across the bridge. He saw a big dog on the other side and the little mouse wanted to show the dog how brave he was. He bowed to the big dog and kept walking.

The big dog didn't like the little mouse and he chased him to the other side. The little mouse was so scared and screamed for help. Unfortunately no-one was around to help him.

The big dog finally caught up with the little mouse and he was so angry. He barked very loudly and the little mouse screamed and ran away as fast as he could.

But it was too late. The big dog had been too fast and the little mouse was never seen again.

Once there was a boat called Sam. It was blue and had a big white sail. Sam sailed on the ocean every day.

One day, the boat was caught in a storm. The waves were so tall that Sam started to struggle. Very soon, Sam was a wreck.

The boat was sorry, but it could not sail anymore. It was broken and floating in the water.

The ocean was sad. It wanted to help the boat. So, the ocean sent a wind to carry Sam to the shore.

Finally, Sam reached the shore and it was safe. The boat was happy and so was the ocean.

Once there was a young boy named Jim. He was playing outside on a beautiful day. He was admiring all the colourful things around him. Then he noticed a heavy sack by the side of the road. He wondered what was inside the sack.

He went over to take a closer look. He was so excited when he saw lots of toys inside the sack. All of the toys were different shapes and sizes. They were so brightly coloured andJim couldn't help but admire them.

He picked up one of the toys and it was very heavy. It was too heavy for Jim to carry. But he was determined to bring it home with him. So he pushed and pulled until the sack was rolling behind him.

Finally, Jim made it back home with the heavy sack of toys. He was so happy with the treasures he had found. Jim spent the rest of the day playing with all the wonderful toys. He knew he would always appreciate and admire the special memories it brought.

Bob was a little boy who had a new neighbor. He was excited to meet them but he was also a bit scared. Bob's neighbor was very big and he was speaking with a deep, rough voice. Bob didn't know what to do, so he decided to rest for a bit. He sat down on the porch and closed his eyes.

The neighbor saw Bob and he smiled. He came close and Bob was surprised, but he felt safe. The neighbor asked Bob if he wanted to play a game and Bob said yes!

They played all afternoon and Bob was getting tired. The neighbor said that it was time to rest and Bob happily agreed. He said goodbye and went back home.

Bob was now sure that his new neighbor was very nice, even if his voice had been a bit scary and rough before. He was grateful that they were friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Alice. She was three years old and very obedient.
One day, her parents took her to the beach. As they strolled along the shore, Alice spotted something shiny in the sand. She ran over to a spot and started to dig.
She pulled out a silver key! She jumped up and down and shouted, "I've found a key!".
Her parents laughed and asked her what she thought the key unlocked.
Alice considered this and frowned. She then smiled and said, "Maybe it unlocks an adventure!"
Her parents smiled and hugged her. They then all started out together, determined to discover the secret of the silver key.

One day, a little boy named Tim lost a tooth. He was very happy because the tooth fairy would come at night. Tim put the tooth under his pillow and went to sleep.

In the dark, a tiny fairy named Lily came to save the tooth. She looked under the pillow and found it. But it was so dark that she could not see well. Lily bumped into a toy and made a loud noise.

Tim woke up and saw Lily. He said, "Who are you?" Lily said, "I am the tooth fairy. I came to save your tooth." Tim smiled and went back to sleep. In the morning, he found a shiny coin under his pillow.

Once upon a time there was a bunny who lived in a green meadow. This bunny had big ears and a big nose. He loved to hop all around the meadow.

One day, he saw something shiny in the grass. When he went closer he saw that it was a comb made out of silver. The bunny was so excited that he wanted to take it with him so he hopped away with it in his mouth.

The bunny stopped to find a safe place to keep the comb. He hopped up the hill and he saw a big tree with a high branch. He figured this would be a perfect place for the comb.

When he tried to hop up the trunk to the high branch, he couldn't reach it. He thought and thought and decided to build a ladder out of logs. He stuck them in the ground and hopped up one by one.

When he finally got to the top, he put the comb carefully on the branch. "There! This is a perfect place to keep the comb safe," said the bunny.
And it was! Whenever he wanted to comb his furry ears he could hop up to the high branch and get it down. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a charming oyster. It lived in the sea and everyone in the village said how beautiful it was.

One day, a boy came to the village. He had a question, and he wanted the oyster to answer it. The boy asked the oyster, â€˜Why are you so charming?â€™

The oyster thought and thought, and then it answered. It said, â€˜Because I love to laugh and dance in the sea!â€™ The boy smiled and thanked the oyster for its answer.

Then he said goodbye and the oyster waved back. From then on, the oyster was known as the most charming oyster in the sea.
